meta.methodiek: Pure linguistic concordant translation. For each Strong-number a single concordant English rendering is chosen on the basis of seven anchors: (1) the consonantal root and its core meaning, (2) the morphology (form, stem, case, number), (3) the stem-family (related Strong-numbers), (4) cognates in related Semitic languages where relevant, (5) the Septuagint as a linguistic witness (not as authority), (6) the word-formation (prefixes, suffixes, derived forms), (7) distribution across the entire Scripture: the word is checked in all occurrences and the common-denominator meaning is identified through context-analysis of each occurrence. No tradition-preference, no theology, no school-choice. Existing English translation traditions (KJV, NIV, ESV, NASB, RSV, NRSV, NET, etc.) are admissible only as external reference, never as authority for the concordant choice.

entries.toelichting: Conjunctive waw prefix. Syntactic base-connector. 'And' covers the additive function; context may imply 'but' or 'then', but concordantly 'and' is held as the base rendering.
Definite article prefix. 'The' as the English definite article; English does not inflect for gender/number, so the rendering is uniform.
Proclitic preposition. Dative/direction: to, for, towards, unto. 'To' preserves the dative-directional core; 'for' or 'unto' are context-splinters of the same particle.
Proclitic preposition. Locative-instrumental: in, on, with, through. 'In' as core locative; extensions depend on context.
Shortened form of min (H4480a) as prefix. 'From' as the ablative core; 'out of' is an alternative for the full-form min. Concordantly 'from' for the prefix variant.
Proclitic preposition of comparison. 'As' covers the comparative core; 'like' (H3644, H834d) is an independent lexeme.
Interrogative prefix (homograph with the definite article Hd, but functionally distinct). Concordantly rendered as the question mark '?' in rendering; English has no prefixal interrogative form.
Proclitic relative (late-Hebrew form, related to asher H834a). Concordantly 'which' as primary form; 'that' or 'who' are grammatical context-variants.
Root 'b. Basic kinship term; parallel em (mother, H517).
Aramaic cognate of H1 av 'father' (Dan 2:23; 5:2,11,13,18; Ezra 4:15; 5:12). Concordantly linked via the '-aramaic' suffix.
The green young plant or shoot - Job 8:12 (he is still in his greenness, not cut off) and Song of Songs 6:11 (to see the young shoots); also the Aramaic 'fruit' in Daniel 4:11-12.

Dan-aramaic-fruit-tree-abundant and Dan-aramaic-fruit-of-it-eat and Dan-aramaic-growing-fruit (Dan 4:9,11,18,21). Hyphenated to distinguish the fruit-aramaic-aspect from H6529 peri-Hebrew 'fruit' (already assigned); aramaic-cognate-tree-fruits.
Proper noun, fourth eunuch attendant of Ahasuerus; Esth 1:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abagtha.

Qal: be lost, perish, vanish. Pi'el and Hiph'il: cause to perish, destroy. The common kernel is 'to no longer exist where one was'. Used both for lost objects (a sheep, Lev 5:23) and for perishing persons (Num 24:20). Hyphenated to preserve the dual-aspect; 'perish' alone leaves the lost-object sense underweight.
Aramaic cognate of H6 avad 'perish' (Dan 2:12,18,24; 4:33; 7:11,26; Ezra 6:12; 7:26; Jer 10:11). Concordantly linked via '-aramaic' suffix to mark the cognate.

Num-end-Amalek-is-unto-perishing and Num-unto-Asshur-shall-carry-captives-and-Eber-shall-see-perishing (Num 24:20,24). Hyphenated to distinguish the perishing-lost-going-down aspect from H9 oved-aramaic 'servant' (already assigned); family with H6 avad 'perish-be-lost' (already assigned) - Balaam-nations-oracles-going-down.

Mislaid object or loss-of-property (Ex 22:8; Lev 5:22,23; Deut 22:3; Isa 11:11). Hyphenated to distinguish the loss-mislaid aspect from H7665 shever 'breaking'; family with H6 avad 'perish-pass-away'.
Destructive ruin as abstract noun - Proverbs 27:20 (Sheol and destruction are never satisfied) and Numbers 24:20 (his end is unto destruction); extended nominal form of H6 avad (perish).

Original concordant: perdition-destruction-place-Abaddon. Place of perdition alongside Sheol and death (Job 26:6; 28:22; 31:12; Ps 88:12; Prov 15:11; 27:20). Hyphenated to distinguish the perdition-destruction-place-aspect from H7585 sheol 'sheol' (already assigned) and H4194 maweth 'death' (already assigned); family with H6 avad 'perish' (already assigned). External-reference NT: Rev 9:11 transliterates as Abaddon (Greek Apollyon).
Qal: consent, be willing; mostly negated (be unwilling); root of evyon (needy); concordantly 'be-willing'. Distinguished from H7521 ratsah 'delight-in' and H2654 chafets 'desire'.
Swift-reed-skiffs with which Job's-days fly away; Job 9:26.

The feeding-trough or manger of livestock - Proverbs 14:4 (where there are no oxen, the manger is empty), Isaiah 1:3 (the ox knows its owner and the donkey its master's manger) and Job 39:9 (will the wild ox lodge by your manger?).
Proper noun, mother of Hezekiah; 2Kgs 18:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abi.

1S-Kish-the-son-of-Abiel-the-son-of-Zeror and 1S-Kish-Saul's-father-and-Ner-Abner's-father-son-of-Abiel (1S 9:1; 14:51). Hyphenated to distinguish the Abiel-grandfather-Saul-Benjamin-aspect from other Abi-names; family with H1 av 'father' (already assigned) - 'my-father-is-God'-theophoric-grandfather-Saul-genealogy-Benjamin.
Proper noun, son of Korah; Ex 6:24; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abiasaph.
Fresh ear-stage of barley; also the name of the Passover-month (Ex 9:31; 13:4; 23:15; 34:18; Deut 16:1; Lev 2:14). Hyphenated to bind the agronomical reference (ear-on-stalk) to the month-meaning.
Proper noun ('my-father-is-joy'); wife of Nabal, later of David; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abigail.
Benjamite tribe-head at the Sinai-numbering (Num 1:11; 2:22; 7:60,65; 10:24). English convention: Abidan. 'My-father-judges'.

Gen-sons-Midian-Ephah-Epher-Henoch-Abida-Eldaah and 1Chr-sons-Midian-Abida (Gen 25:4; 1Chr 1:33). Hyphenated to distinguish the Abida-son-Midian-Abraham-grandson-aspect from other theophoric-names; Midianite-line-third-generation-Abraham.
Proper noun ('my-father-is-YHWH'); multiple persons; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abijah.

Second son of Aaron and Elisheba (Ex 6:23, 24:1,9, 28:1); offered strange fire with Nadab and was consumed together with him (Lev 10:1-2, Num 3:2,4, 26:60-61, 1Chr 6:3, 24:1-2); 'He-is-Father'; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abihu.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head, son of Bela; 1Chr 8:3; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abihud.
Several persons in Levitical and royal genealogies (Num 3:35; 1Chr 2:29; 5:14; 2Chr 11:18; Esth 2:15; 9:29). 'My-father-is-strength'. English convention: Abihail.
Abiezrite-Gideon's-clan and Gideon-burial-place (Judg 6:11,24; 8:32). English convention: Abiezrite. Family with H44 Aviezer 'Abiezer' (already assigned); ethnonym-clan-adjective.
Longing/lacking; from √avah (to long for); social underclass alongside ani and dal; the hyphenated English captures lack-plus-longing.
Hapax Eccl 12:5 caper-berry-fails-stimulus; plant-identity uncertain but capparis-tradition.
Proper noun, Benjamin-son of Shaharaim; 1Chr 8:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abitub.

2S-the-fifth-Shephatiah-the-son-of-Abital and 1Chr-the-fifth-Shephatiah-of-Abital (2S 3:4; 1Chr 3:3). Hyphenated to distinguish the Abital-wife-David-mother-Shephatiah-aspect from other Abi-names; family with H1 av 'father' (already assigned) - 'my-father-is-dew'-theophoric-David's-fifth-wife-Hebron.
King of Judah, son of Rehoboam (1Kgs 14:31; 15:1,7,8; 2Chr 11:20,22; 12:16). English convention: Abijam. 'Father-of-sea'. Distinguished from H29 Abijah (same person, different name-form).

Gen-Joktan-begat-Obal-Abimael-Sheba and 1Chr-Abimael (Gen 10:28; 1Chr 1:22). Hyphenated to distinguish the Abimael-son-Joktan-Arabian-tribe-aspect from other theophoric-names; 'my-father-is-God'-patronymic-Joktanite.
Proper noun ('my father is king'); concordantly transliterated; multiple persons in the Tanakh.

Multiple persons: son of Jesse (1Sam 16:8), keeper of the ark (1Sam 7:1), son of Saul (1Sam 31:2), district-officer under Solomon (1Kgs 4:11); concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abinadab.
Father of judge Barak from Kedesh (Judg 4:6,12; 5:1,12). English convention: Abinoam. 'Father-of-pleasantness'; family with H5278 no'am 'pleasantness'.

Ebiasaph-Korahite-Levitical-genealogy and temple-singers-descent (1Chr 6:8,22; 9:19). English convention: Ebiasaph. 'My-father-has-gathered' or 'father-of-gathering' (av-father + asaph-gather already assigned).
Manassite tribe-head and Gideon's family-clan (Josh 17:2; Judg 6:34; 8:2; 2Sam 23:27; 1Chr 7:18; 11:28; 27:12). 'My-father-is-help'. English convention: Abiezer.
Proper noun, one of David's mighty men, an Arbathite; 2Sam 23:31; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abi-albon.

Mighty-bull as title of Jacob's God or as leader-stallion (Gen 49:24; Ps 132:2,5; Isa 1:24; 49:26; 60:16). Hyphenated to distinguish the bull-mighty-divine-title from H47 abbir 'strong-mighty' (the adjective).
Poetic term for bull, warrior, bird-of-prey (strength); the hyphenated English marks intensity. Family with H46 abir 'bull-mighty' (the noun-title).

Son of Eliab, Reubenite who rebelled with Dathan and Korah against Moses (Num 16:1,12,24,25,27, 26:9, Deut 11:6, Ps 106:17 earth swallows up); also firstborn of Hiel at Jericho-rebuilding (1Kgs 16:34); 'my-father-is-exalted'; concordantly transliterated.
Shunammite who warmed David in his old age (1Kgs 1:3,15; 2:17,21,22). English convention: Abishag. 'My-father-is-wanderer'.
Priest-descendant of Phinehas, and Benjamite (1Chr 5:30,31; 6:35; 8:4; Ezra 7:5). English convention: Abishua. 'Father-is-salvation'.

1Chr-and-Shammai-the-brother-of-Jada-Nadab-and-Abishur and 1Chr-and-the-name-of-the-wife-of-Abishur-was-Abihail-and-she-bore-him-Ahban-and-Molid (1Chr 2:28,29). Hyphenated to distinguish the Abishur-son-Shammai-married-Abihail-Ahban-Molid-aspect from other Abi-names; family with H1 av 'father' (already assigned) - 'my-father-is-wall'-pn-Shammai-second-son-wife-Abihail-two-sons-Jerahmeel-side-line-Caleb-brother.
Proper noun ('father-of-gift'); brother of Joab, captain under David; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abishai.
Proper noun ('father-of-abundance'); priest under David; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abiathar.
Qal/Hithpael: give expression to grief over a deceased one or a calamity; concordantly 'mourn'.

Participle of aval 'mourn'. The mourning one as state-designation (Gen 37:35; Isa 57:18; 61:2,3; Lam 1:4; Esth 6:12; Job 29:25; Ps 35:14). Distinguished from H56 aval 'mourn' (verb) and H60 evel 'mourning' (noun).
Northern border-city near Dan and mourning-name (1Sam 6:18; 2Sam 20:14,15,18). English convention: Abel. 'Meadow-pasture-place'. Distinguished from H1893 Hevel-Abel-person (already assigned).
From √aval (to grieve); state of sorrow with outward sign; concordantly 'mourning'.

Affirmative/adversative particle 'truly' or 'however'; confession (Gen 42:21 Joseph's-brothers 'truly we are guilty'), promise-confirmation (Gen 17:19 'verily Sarah shall bear'), court-politics (2Sam 14:5, 1Kgs 1:43), realisation (2Kgs 4:14 Shunammite-childless), prophetic-insight (Dan 10:7,21), administrative (Ezra 10:13, 2Chr 1:4, 19:3, 33:17); concordantly 'verily'. Distinguished from H56 aval 'mourn' (verb-homonym).

1K-and-he-smote-Ijon-and-Dan-and-Abel-Beth-Maacah-and-all-Chinneroth and 2K-he-took-Ijon-and-Abel-Beth-Maacah-and-Janoah (1K 15:20; 2K 15:29). Hyphenated to distinguish the Abel-Beth-Maacah-Naphtali-northern-city-aspect from H1038 Beth-Maacah-alone (already assigned); family with H63 Abel-place and H1004b bayit-house (both already assigned) - 'meadow-house-Maacah'-Dan-Naphtali-Asa-Benhadad-capture-Tiglath-Pileser-exile.
Proper noun ('mourning-acacia-field'), Moab-plain; Num 33:49; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abel-shittim.
Proper noun ('mourning-vineyards'), Jephthah-border; Judg 11:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abel-cheramim.

Judg-the-host-fled-as-far-as-Beth-Shittah-toward-Zererah-to-the-border-of-Abel-Meholah and 1K-Elisha-the-son-of-Shaphat-of-Abel-Meholah (Judg 7:22; 1K 19:16). Hyphenated to distinguish the Abel-Meholah-city-Jordan-aspect from other Abel-names; family with H57 avel 'meadow' (already assigned) - 'meadow-of-the-dance'-compound-birthplace-Elisha-Gideon-victory.
Proper noun ('mourning-waters'), variant of Abel-Beth-Maacah; 2Chr 16:4; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abel-maim.
Proper noun ('mourning-of-Egypt'), threshing-floor of Atad; Gen 50:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abel-mizraim.
Aramaic equivalent for building-stone (Ezra 5:8; 6:4; Dan 2:34,35,45; 5:4,23; 6:18). Hyphenated to mark the Aramaic-parallel; family with H68 even 'stone' (Hebrew).

Ex-Pharaoh-to-midwives-when-they-see-on-the-birth-stones and Jer-I-went-down-to-the-house-of-the-potter-he-was-doing-work-on-the-wheels (Ex 1:16; Jer 18:3). Hyphenated to distinguish the birth-stones-potter's-wheel-aspect from H68 even 'stone' (already assigned); dual-form-two-stones-birth-stool-and-potter's-wheel-pair.
River of Damascus 2Kgs 5:12 Naaman-healing-doubt; also Amana-spelling.
Priestly sash/ceremonial girdle (Ex 28:4,39,40; 29:9; 39:29; Lev 8:7,13; 16:4; Isa 22:21). Hyphenated; distinguished from H2290 chagorah 'girdle' (military) and emphasises the band-character.
Proper noun ('father-is-light' or 'my-father-is-ner'); commander of Saul's army; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Abner.

1K-ten-fat-oxen-and-twenty-pasture-oxen-and-a-hundred-sheep and Prov-better-is-a-dish-of-green-herbs-where-love-is-than-a-fatted-ox-and-hatred-with-it (1K 4:23; Prov 15:17). Hyphenated to distinguish the fattened-stall-fed-livestock-fully-fed-aspect from H80 avaq-dust (already assigned) as phonetically-near; Solomon-daily-royal-provision-Proverbs-love-above-luxury-said.

Ex-and-it-shall-become-dust-on-all-the-land-Egypt-and-on-man-and-on-beast-boils-breaking-out-with-blisters and Ex-boils-breaking-out-pustules (Ex 9:9,10). Hyphenated to distinguish the boils-blisters-pustules-aspect from H1158 ba'ah 'boil-up' (possible-root); sixth-plague-skin-disease-specific-term-unique.
Proper noun, Issachar-city; Josh 19:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ebez.

Judg-after-him-Ibzan-judged-Israel-who-was-of-Bethlehem and Judg-he-judged-Israel-seven-years-and-Ibzan-died (Judg 12:8,10). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ibzan-judge-Bethlehem-aspect from other names; minor-judge-between-Jephthah-and-Elon-thirty-sons-thirty-daughters-Bethlehem-Judah.

Gen-a-man-wrestled-with-Jacob-until-the-dawn-rising and Gen-while-he-wrestled-with-him (Gen 32:25,26). Hyphenated to distinguish the wrestle-raise-dust-aspect from H80 avaq 'dust-powder' (already assigned) as same-root-verbal-form; Jacob-Peniel-angel-fight-imagery-dust-whirling.
Finely-pulverised dust of soot or cattle-hoof (Ex 9:9; Deut 28:24; Isa 5:24; 29:5; Eze 26:10; Nah 1:3). Hyphenated to distinguish the fine-grained powder-dust from H6083 afar 'earth-dust' (coarser).

Ps-dove-with-silver-wings-flying and Isa-eagles-wings-strength and Eze-great-eagle-mighty-wings (Ps 55:7; Isa 40:31; Eze 17:3). Hyphenated to distinguish the wing-pinion-flight-feather-wing-stroke-aspect from H3671a kanaf 'wing' (already assigned) and H82 avar-verb 'rise-up-fly' (already assigned); family with H82 avar - poetic-bird-wing-side-form.

Eagle-pinion-image of protection (Deut 32:11; Job 39:13; Ps 68:14; 91:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the pinion-feather-aspect from H5133 notsah 'feathers-plume' and H3671 kanaf 'wing'; family with H83 aver 'great-wing'.
Proper noun; extended form of Avram (H87). English convention Abraham.
Heraldic exclamation for Joseph; Gen 41:43; concordantly transliterated. Etymology uncertain (possibly Egyptian loan); the kneel-down sense is followed by tradition.
Proper noun ('high father'); pre-covenant name; concordantly transliterated (distinguished from Abraham H85).
Stopping-place on the exodus-route eastern-Edom (Num 21:10,11; 33:43,44). English convention: Oboth. 'Water-skins-leather-pouches'.
Proper noun, father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men; 2Sam 23:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Agee.
Amalekite king-type (Num 24:7; 1Sam 15:8,9,20,32,33; Esth 3:1,10; 8:3,5; 9:24 Agagite). English convention: Agag.
Descent-designation of Amalek-king Agag (Esth 3:1,10; 8:3,5; 9:24). Gentilic; family with H90 Agag.

Bound-together hyssop-bunch or troops-band (Ex 12:22; 2Sam 2:25; Amos 9:6; Isa 58:6). Hyphenated to distinguish the bundle-binding-aspect from H6014a amar-II 'bind-stack' and H485 allumah 'bound-grain-sheaf' (already assigned); family with H97 agam 'reeds'.
Proper noun, son-of-Yake-proverb-maker; Prov 30:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Agur.
Proper noun, Moabite place of lamentation; Isa 15:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eglaim.

Standing-water-pool surrounded-by reed-or-rush distinguished from yam (sea), tehom (deep), bor (cistern, H953a) by the reed-bordered-marsh-character (Ex 7:19, 8:1,5 plague 'Aaron's-staff over-the-waters-of-Egypt, over-rivers, over-Niles, over-pools and-on-all-collections-of-water', Ps 107:35 'He-makes wilderness into reed-pool-water and-dry-land into springs-of-water', 114:8 'Rock turning-into reed-pool-water, flint-into water-fountain', Isa 14:23 Babel-judgment 'I-will-make-her into-possession-of hedgehogs and reed-pools-of-water', 35:7 'parched-place shall-become reed-pool and-thirsty-land springs-of-water', 41:18 'in-high-places I-open rivers and-in-the-midst-of valleys springs, I-will-make-the-wilderness into reed-pool-water and-dry-land into water-springs', 42:15 'I-will-dry-up mountains and-hills and-all-their-herbage I-will-wither, and-I-make rivers into-islands and reed-pools I-will-dry-up'); concordantly 'reed-pool' distinguishes the reed-environment-aspect from a plain pool.

Pliable water-rush or rush-cord (Job 40:26; 41:12; Isa 9:13; 19:15; 58:5). Hyphenated to distinguish the rush-reed-aspect from H7070 qaneh 'reed' and H5488 suph 'reed-grass'; family with H98 agam 'pool'.

Sacrificial blood-basins at Sinai and fountain-bowl (Ex 24:6; Song 7:2; Isa 22:24). Concordantly hyphenated to distinguish the basin-bowl-cup-aspect from H4219 mizraq sprinkling-basin, H3713a kefor-I bowl and H5592 saph-II threshold-bowl. Occurrence-correction: 3 instead of 4 (audit-2026-04-26).

Military-troops surrounding king or commander; all 7 occurrences in Ezekiel (12:14; 17:21; 38:6 [2x], 38:9, 38:22, 39:4) at Gog-army and Egypt-king. Fully restored after duplicate-audit 2026-04-26: master had erroneously contained aggan-bowl data (H101-overlap).

Wine-harvest-not-gathered and ant-harvest-collecting and son-harvest-time (Deut 28:39; Prov 6:8; 10:5). Hyphenated to distinguish the gather-harvest-collect-store-up-aspect from H622 asaph 'gather-in' (already assigned) and H6908 qavats 'gather' (already assigned) and H3950 laqat 'pick-up-glean' (already assigned); harvest-technical.

The ordinary Aramaic designation for letter or missive - Ezra 4:8, 4:11, 5:6; Aramaic parallel to Hebrew iggeret H107 (already assigned); distinguished from H5407 nishtevana as the more official rescript-designation.
The gold and silver offering-bowls that Cyrus handed over to Sheshbazzar for the temple-treasury - Ezra 1:9 (29 knives, 30 bowls, 1000 silver bowls); Persian loanword.

Ex-when-men-strive-and-one-strikes-his-neighbour-with-stone-or-fist and Isa-to-strike-with-godless-fist (Ex 21:18; Isa 58:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the fist-clenched-hand-strike-aspect from other hand-terms; quarrel-violence-distinction-bodily-injury.

Unique lexeme. Master-form; in vocative 1cs-form adonay (H136). 'Lord' standard - covers both the secular master sense and the divine title. The lowercase form is held; capitalisation is rendering, not lexical.
Proper noun, Babylonian place of returnees without genealogy; Neh 7:61; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Addon.
Proper noun, Judah-fortress-city built by Rehoboam; 2Chr 11:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adoraim.

Root 'dm (to be red); connection with adamah (ground, H127). 'Human' covers both the generic ('humanity') and the individual; the proper noun Adam is a homograph. 'Human' chosen over 'man' to preserve the gender-neutral kernel - the Hebrew adam is grammatically masculine but semantically inclusive (Gen 1:27 'male and female he created them' both within ha-adam).

First human as proper noun (Gen 4:25, 5:1-5 'this is the register of generations of Adam', 1Chr 1:1 genealogy-start, Deut 32:8 'when the Most High gave the nations their inheritance... according to the number of the sons of Adam/Mighty', Job 31:33 'hide-as-Adam', Ps 68:19 = Eph 4:8 context, Hos 6:7 'you like Adam transgressed the covenant', Josh 3:16 place-Adam); concordantly transliterated, distinguished from adam (human, H120).
Colour-state 'red' of stone, skin or horse (Num 19:2; 2Kgs 3:22; Prov 23:31; Song 5:10; Isa 63:2; Lam 4:7; Zech 1:8; 6:2). Distinguishes adjective from H119 adam-II 'redden' (verb).

Zech-russet-horses-and-bay-and-white and Zech-first-chariot-red-horses-second-black (Zech 1:8; 6:2 cf). Hyphenated to distinguish the sorrel-russet-horse-colour-aspect from H122a adom-general-red-colour (already assigned) as specific-horse-colour-shade; Zechariah-vision-horses-colour-palette.

Ex-first-row-ruby-topaz-emerald and Eze-ruby-topaz-jasper-chrysolite (Ex 28:17; 39:10; Eze 28:13). Hyphenated to distinguish the ruby-carnelian-red-gem-aspect from H122a adom 'red' (already assigned); family-same-root-red-stone-breastplate-priest-Reuben-tribe.
Reddish tint at skin-disease-spot (Lev 13:19,24,42,43,49; 14:37). Hyphenated to preserve tint-gradation-colour-on-skin; family with H119 adom 'be-red' and H122 adom 'red'.
One of the five cities of Sodom's plain (Gen 10:19; 14:2,8; Deut 29:22; Hos 11:8). English convention: Admah.
Root 'dm (to be red); linked to adam (H120). 'Ground' as red-earth; 'land' (H776) is broader territorial.
Proper noun, Naphtali-city; Josh 19:36; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adamah.
Proper noun, Naphtali-border-place; Josh 19:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adami-nekeb.

Ethnonym-adjective of Edom (H123) - inhabitant-or-descendant of-Esau-people (Gen 36:9,21,31, Deut 23:8 'you-shall-not-abhor an Edomite for he-is-your-brother'), Saul's slaughter-Nob-servant (1Sam 21:8 'Doeg the Edomite chief-shepherd of-Saul'), political-opposition (2Sam 8:14, 1Kgs 11:14-17 'Hadad the Edomite of royal-seed of-Edom'), esp. in Ps 7-title 'of-David concerning-Cush the-Benjamite'; concordantly 'Edomite' distinguishes ethnonym-suffix -i from country-name.

Josh-border-went-up-toward-Debir-from-the-valley-of-Achor-and-northward-looking-toward-Gilgal-which-is-opposite-the-ascent-of-Adummim and Josh-border-came-down-along-the-eastern-side-toward-Gilgal-which-is-opposite-the-ascent-of-Adummim (Josh 15:7; 18:17). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adummim-ascent-border-Judah-Benjamin-aspect from other Edom-related-names; border-Judah-Benjamin-paired-ascent-name-'ascent-of-the-red-ones'.

Gen-Esau-came-out-ruddy-all-like-a-hairy-mantle and 1Sam-David-was-ruddy-with-fair-eyes-and-handsome-of-appearance (Gen 25:25; 1Sam 16:12; 17:42). Hyphenated to distinguish the ruddy-red-tinge-complexion-aspect from H122a adom 'red' (already assigned); family with H119 adam 'become-red' (already assigned) - red-complexion-person-description.
Proper noun, Persian counsellor third position; Esth 1:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Admatha.
Base-piece in which tabernacle-boards rest; concordantly 'socket-base'; distinguished from the proper noun Adonai.
Proper noun, Babylonian place of returnees without genealogy-proof; Ezra 2:59; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Addan.
Proper-noun-form of adon (H113). Morphologically 1cs-pronominal: literally 'my-lord(s)'. 'My-Lord' with hyphen preserves the morphological composition.
Proper noun ('my-Lord-is-YHWH'); son of David; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adonijah.

Josh-Adoni-Zedek-king-of-Jerusalem-heard-that-Joshua-took-Ai and Josh-Adoni-Zedek-sent-to-Hoham-king-Hebron-to-Piram-king-Jarmuth (Josh 10:1,3). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adoni-Zedek-king-Jerusalem-coalition-aspect from other kings; family with H113 adon 'lord' (already assigned) - 'lord-of-my-righteousness'-theophoric-five-kings-coalition-Josh-10.
Adonikam-family-head-of-returnees-from-exile-six-hundred-sixty-six (Ezra 2:13; 8:13; Neh 7:18). English convention: Adonikam. 'My-Lord-has-arisen' (adon-lord + qum-arise already assigned).
Proper noun, Solomon's-tribute-overseer; 1Kgs 4:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adoniram.

Ex-Your-right-hand-LORD-glorious-in-power and Ps-how-excellent-is-Your-Name-in-all-the-earth (Ex 15:10; Ps 8:2,10). Hyphenated to distinguish the mighty-excellent-noble-aspect from H117 addir 'ruler-illustrious' (already assigned) as attributive-form; victory-song-Moses-God-majesty.
Twelfth month of the Jewish calendar, name from the Persian period (Ezra 6:15; Esth 3:7,13; 8:12; 9:1,15,17,19,21). Month-name untranslated; no hyphen.
Aramaic-proper-noun twelfth month (Feb/Mar); Ezra 6:15; concordantly transliterated.

Original concordant: proper-name-Eder-Merari-Levite. Proper noun Eder, son of Mushi from the Merari-Levites - in 1Chronicles 23:23 (the children of Mushi were Mahli and Eder and Jeremoth, three) and 1Chronicles 24:30 (the children of Mushi were Mahli and Eder and Jerimoth); distinguished from H145a eder-I (flock) by personal-name-reference.

Josh-border-went-out-southward-to-the-ascent-of-Akrabbim-passed-along-Zin-went-up-from-south-to-Kadesh-Barnea-went-through-Hezron-went-up-to-Addar and Num-border-turned-toward-Hatsar-Addar-went-through-Azmon (Josh 15:3; Num 34:4 cf). Hyphenated to distinguish the Addar-border-city-Judah-south-aspect from other Addar-names; south-border-promised-land-border-Judah-Num-34-Josh-15-pair.
Aramaic threshing-floor (Dan 2:35 summer-threshing-floors); cognate Hebrew H1637 goren different stem.

Original concordant: counsellor-supreme-commander-aramaic. Aramaic loanword for counsellor or supreme commander - in Daniel 3:2 (the satraps, the prefects, the governors) and Daniel 3:3 (the satraps, the prefects, the governors); officials-list at Nebuchadnezzar's image-dedication.

2Sam-Adoram-was-over-the-tribute and 1Kgs-king-Rehoboam-sent-Adoram-who-was-over-the-tribute (2Sam 20:24; 1Kgs 12:18). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adoram-corvee-overseer-aspect from other Adoni-names; family with H113 adon 'lord' (already assigned) - 'lord-is-exalted'-overseer-corvee-stoned-Rehoboam-secession.

2Kgs-and-the-Sepharvites-burned-their-sons-with-fire-to-Adrammelech-and-Anammelech-the-gods-of-Sepharvaim and 2Kgs-and-Adrammelech-and-Sharezer-his-sons-struck-him-with-the-sword (2Kgs 17:31; 19:37). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adrammelech-Sepharvite-god-and-son-Sennacherib-aspect from other Mlk-names; family with H142 adir 'mighty' and H4428 melek 'king' (both already assigned) - 'mighty-king-god-name'-Mesopotamian-cult-child-sacrifice-Sennacherib-murder-son-Nisroch-temple-Esarhaddon-successor.
Aramaic arm-with-strength (Ezra 4:23 Persian-army-arm); variant H1872 dera.
Capital of Og, king of Bashan (Num 21:33; Deut 1:4; 3:1,10; Josh 12:4; 13:12,31; 19:37). Aramaic 'mighty'. English convention: Edrei.
From √adar (to be glorious); splendid-garment (Elijah's mantle, Joseph's blood-mantle); the hyphenated English marks size and dignity.
Root 'hb. 'Love' is the kernel-activity; derived ahavah (love, H160).
The love or caresses - Proverbs 5:19 (let her breasts intoxicate you at all times, wander always in her love) and Hosea 8:9 (Ephraim has hired lovers); from H157 ahav (to love).
From √ahav (to love); strong devotion between persons or to YHWH; concordantly 'love'.

Gen-sons-Simeon-Jemuel-Jamin-Ohad-Jachin-Zohar and Ex-sons-Simeon-Jemuel-Jamin-Ohad (Gen 46:10; Ex 6:15). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ohad-son-Simeon-tribe-head-aspect from others; Simeon-third-son-not-in-Num-26-numbering.
Onomatopoeic lament-cry of fright/distress (Josh 7:7, Judg 6:22, Jer 1:6 'Alas, Lord YHWH!', Eze 4:14, Joel 1:15); concordantly 'Alas!' as English equivalent-interjection.

Benjamite judge-deliverer of-Israel from-Moab-king-Eglon via-assassination (Judg 3:15-16,20-21,23,26 core-account 'sons-of-Israel cried to-YHWH, and-YHWH gave-them a-deliverer: Ehud son-of-Gera the-Benjamite, a-man bound at-his-right-hand; and-the-sons-of-Israel sent by-his-hand a-tribute to-Eglon-king-of-Moab; and-Ehud-made-himself a-sword that-had-two-edges length-of-a-cubit, and-he-girded-it under-his-clothes upon-his-right-thigh... Ehud-came-to-him, and-he sat in-a-cool-chamber upper-alone; and-Ehud-said: a-word-of-God I-have-to-you; and-he-rose up from-his-throne; and-Ehud put-out his-left-hand and-took-the-sword from-his-right-thigh and-thrust-it-into his-belly', 4:1 death-Ehud 'when Ehud died, the-sons-of-Israel did again the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH'), 1Chr 7:10, 8:6 Benjamite-genealogy); concordantly transliterated; distinguished from H261 Ehud.

Hos-where-is-your-king-that-he-may-save-you and Hos-where-are-your-rulers and Hos-I-am-where-is-your-plague (Hos 13:10 twice, 13:14). Hyphenated to distinguish the where-is-he-where-then-where-aspect from H346 ayyeh 'where-is' (already assigned) as variant-question-word; Hosea-exclusively-rhetorical-question.
Hiphil; even moon-not-bright before God; Job 25:5.

Original concordant: pitch-tent-take-up-tent-dwelling. Abraham-pitching-tents and city-without-tent (Gen 13:12,18; Isa 13:20). Hyphenated to distinguish the pitch-tent-take-up-aspect from H3427 yashav 'dwell' (already assigned) and H7931 shakhan 'tabernacle' (already assigned); family with H168 ohel 'tent' (already assigned).
Proper noun, son of Zerubbabel; 1Chr 3:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ohel.
Symbolic name for Samaria in Eze 23 (Eze 23:4,5,36,44). English convention: Oholah. 'Her-tent'; family with H168 ohel 'tent'.
Danite tent-maker-helper of Bezalel at the tabernacle-construction (Ex 31:6; 35:34; 36:1,2; 38:23). English convention: Oholiab. 'Tent-of-father'.
Allegorical name for Jerusalem in Ezekiel's narrative (Eze 23:4,11,22,36,44). 'My-tent-is-in-her'. English convention: Oholibah.
Wife of Esau, Hittite; also tribe-head-name in Edom-lists (Gen 36:2,5,14,18,25,41; 1Chr 1:52). 'Tent-of-the-high-place'. English convention: Oholibamah.
Fragrant-wood as perfume or image (Num 24:6; Ps 45:9; Prov 7:17; Song 4:14). Hyphenated to distinguish the aloe-fragrance-aspect from H168 ohel 'tent' and H3828 levonah 'frankincense'.
Proper noun, son of Bani who took foreign-wife; Ezra 10:34; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Uel.
Diviner who consults the spirits of the deceased (Saul at Endor); the noun marks the profession. Distinguished from H3049 yidoni 'familiar-spirit-knower'.
Proper noun, Ishmaelite David's-camel-overseer; 1Chr 27:30; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Obil.

Dan-by-the-Ulai-river and Dan-vision-along-the-stream and Dan-before-Ulai-watercourse (Dan 8:2,3,6). Hyphenated to distinguish the watercourse-stream-aspect from H5104 nahar 'river' (already assigned) and H5158 nachal 'brook' (already assigned); family with H2975 yeor 'Nile-canal' (already assigned) - specific-Ulai-Elam-water-channel.

Amos-as-firebrand-out-of-the-burning-saved and Zech-firebrand-snatched-from-fire and Isa-smoking-firebrand-piece (Amos 4:11; Zech 3:2; Isa 7:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the firebrand-glowing-firewood-coal-furnace-aspect from H5749b ud 'witnesses' (already assigned) and H6086 ets 'tree-wood' (already assigned) and H1197a ba'ar 'burn' (already assigned) and H6352 pecham 'charcoal' (also-this-batch); rescue-from-fire-metaphor.
Substantive 'cause/reason', always in construct 'al-odot' = 'on-account-of' (Gen 21:11,25, 26:32, Ex 18:8, Num 12:1, 13:24, Josh 14:6, Judg 6:7, Jer 3:8); concordantly 'cause' as lemma.
Piel/Hithpael: strong longing, fierce craving (not always negative); concordantly 'crave'. Distinguished from H14 avah 'be-willing' (homonym different root).

Intense inward longing for food or matter (Gen 3:16 (?); Num 11:4,34; Deut 12:15,20,21; 14:26; 18:6; Job 23:13; Ps 78:29,30; Isa 26:8; Hos 10:10; Mic 7:3). Hyphenated; intensification of H183 avah 'crave'.
Father of wall-builder Palal Neh 3:25; short proper noun, uncertain meaning.
Uzal-son-of-Joktan and Tyre-trade-partner (Gen 10:27; 1Chr 1:21; Eze 27:19). English convention: Uzal. Possibly Arabic-Sana (old capital of Yemen).
Lament-cry at calamity or judgment; the hyphenated English marks the exclamation-function.

Num-killed-with-their-slain-Evi-Rekem-Zur-Hur-Reba-five-kings-Midian and Josh-Evi-Rekem-Zur-Hur-Reba-kings-Sihon-Amorite-who-dwelt-in-the-land (Num 31:8; Josh 13:21). Hyphenated to distinguish the Evi-king-Midian-defeated-aspect from other names; Midianite-five-kings-list-first-name-Moses-war.
Woe-is-me that I sojourn in Meshech; Ps 120:5.
Moral fool in wisdom-literature, coarse and unbending; concordantly 'fool' (distinguished from kesil, sakhal).

2Kgs-and-it-came-to-pass-in-the-thirty-seventh-year-of-the-captivity-of-Jehoiachin-the-king-of-Judah-in-the-twelfth-month-when-Evil-merodach-the-king-of-Babylon-received-the-kingdom and Jer-id (2Kgs 25:27; Jer 52:31 par). Hyphenated to distinguish the Evil-Merodach-Babylonian-king-Jehoiachin-release-aspect from other Mrdk-names; Akkadian-Amel-Marduk-son-Nebuchadnezzar-amnesty-Jewish-king-37th-exile-year-table-of-honour-king-gate-final-verse-2Kgs-hope-remnant.

Original concordant: proper-name-Ulai-river-Susa. Proper noun Ulai, river near Susa (modern Karun/Karkheh) - in Daniel 8:2 (and I saw in a vision that I was by the river Ulai) and Daniel 8:16 (he called from between the Ulai); scene-location of Daniel's ram-and-goat-vision.
Bani-family-member who sends-back foreign-wife (Ezra 10:34). English convention: Uel. 'Will-of-God'; family with H410 el 'God' (already assigned).
Adversative conjunction; the English 'however' marks the concession (distinguished from ulam noun 'vestibule').
Abstract of ewil; moral foolishness, stubborn obtuseness; concordantly 'folly'.
Omar-son-of-Eliphaz and Edomite-clan-chief (Gen 36:11,15; 1Chr 1:36). English convention: Omar. 'Speaking' or 'He-speaks'.
Procreative-strength, vitality (Gen 49, Reuben as 'firstfruits of my strength'); the hyphenated English distinguishes from on-II 'mischief' and the proper noun Ono.
Proper noun, son of Peleth, fellow-rebel of Korah; Num 16:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: On.
On-Egyptian-priest-city where Joseph's-father-in-law-lives (Gen 41:45,50; 46:20). English convention: On (also: Heliopolis). Egyptian 'Iunu', Greek-Heliopolis 'sun-city'.
Root 'wn. Emptiness, calamity, unrighteousness. 'Iniquity' preserves the moral evil-dimension; 'vanity' is too weak, 'wickedness' clashes with rasha.

Original concordant: proper-name-Aven-Heliopolis-Egyptian-On. Proper noun Aven (Heliopolis, Egyptian On) - in Amos 1:5 (I will cut off the inhabitant from Bikath-aven) and Ezekiel 30:17 (the young men of Aven and Pibeseth shall fall by the sword); wordplay with H205 aven (iniquity).
Benjamite city on the lowland plain (1Chr 8:12; Ezra 2:33; Neh 6:2; 7:37; 11:35). English convention: Ono. 'Strength'.
Onam-Horite-son-of-Shobal and Jerahmeelite-descendant (Gen 36:23; 1Chr 1:40; 2:26,28). English convention: Onam. 'Strong' or 'powerful' (family with H202 on-I 'strength').
Second son of Judah by Shua; unwilling brother in levirate-context (Gen 38:4,8,9; 46:12; Num 26:19; 1Chr 2:3). From aven 'mischief-strength'; but as proper noun: Onan.

Original concordant: proper-name-Uphaz-gold-land. Proper noun Uphaz (legendary gold-source) - in Jeremiah 10:9 (beaten silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz) and Daniel 10:5 (his loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz); possibly variant of Ophir.
Proper noun; legendary gold-land (Arabian peninsula/India), Solomon's trade-destination; concordantly transliterated.
Rolling wheel of chariot or throne-chariot (Ezekiel); concordantly 'wheel'.

Qal: urge/hasten - Gen 19:15 angels urge Lot, Ex 5:13 'taskmasters pressed', Josh 10:13 sun-not-hastened, 17:15 'land oppresses', 1Sam 20:38 Jonathan urges boy, Prov 19:2 'he that is hasty with his feet', 21:5 'every one that is hasty unto want', 28:20, 29:20, Isa 22:4 'do not press to comfort me'.
From √atsar (to store up); place of storage; concordantly 'treasury' (not the treasure itself).
Qal: shine; Hiphil: cause-to-shine; the hyphenated English marks the causative aspect.

Light-fire as element of judgment (Isa 24:15; 31:9; 44:16; 47:14; 50:11; Eze 5:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the light-fire-flash-aspect from H216 or 'light' and H784 esh 'fire'; family with H215 or 'illuminate'; distinguished from homonym H217b ur-II 'place-name Ur'.
Second-sense ur; honour YHWH in east-light-regions; Isa 24:15.
Proper noun, father of Eliphal one of David's-warriors; 1Chr 11:35; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ur.
Chaldean home-city of Abraham (Gen 11:28,31; 15:7; Neh 9:7). English convention: Ur. Distinguished from homonym H217a ur-I 'light-fire-flash'.
The light of joy and deliverance - Esther 8:16 (the Jews had light, gladness, joy and honour) and Psalm 139:12 (the darkness is as the light to You); from H215 or (light).
Second-sense orot; gathered field-herbs in stew; 2Kgs 4:39.
Father of Bezalel, the tabernacle-craftsman, and other namesakes (Ex 31:2; 35:30; 38:22; 1Kgs 4:19; 1Chr 2:20; 2Chr 1:5; Ezra 10:24). 'My-light'. English convention: Uri.
Levite-Kohathite-head and grandfather of Abijah (1Chr 6:24; 15:5,11; 2Chr 13:2). English convention: Uriel. 'God-is-my-light'; family with H217 or 'light'.
Proper noun ('my-light-is-YHWH'); Hittite, husband of Bathsheba, and others; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Uriah.
Second-sense Uriah; prophet-from-Kiriath-jearim killed by Jehoiakim; Jer 26:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Urijah.

Oracle-instrument in the breastplate of the high priest, together with H8550 Tummim (Ex 28:30; Lev 8:8; Num 27:21; Deut 33:8; 1Sam 28:6; Ezra 2:63; Neh 7:65). Untranslated; concordantly preserved. English convention: Urim.
Agree to terms of covenant (Gen 34:15,22,23; 2Kgs 12:9). Hyphenated to distinguish the consent-agree-aspect from H6030 anah 'answer' and H3820 lev 'heart'.
Recognisable mark with referential function; concordantly 'sign' (not miracle, not proof).
Time-marking adverb: at that moment, formerly; concordantly 'then'.

Dan-aramaic-furnace-heated-sevenfold and Dan-aramaic-command-furnace-heat and Dan-aramaic-furnace-so-heated (Dan 3:19,22). Hyphenated to distinguish the heat-furnace-stoke-aramaic-aspect from H3341 yatsath-Hebrew 'kindle' (already assigned); Aramaic-specific-furnace-heating.
Proper noun, father of Naarai one of David's-warriors; 1Chr 11:37; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ezbai.
Aramaic-Persian loan (Dan 2 royal-decree-irrevocable); word-stem Persian uncertain.

Small, aromatic herb-plant (possibly Origanum syriacum) specifically used in-purification-rituals (Ex 12:22 Passover-instruction 'you-shall-take a-bunch-of-hyssop and-dip in-the-blood that-is-in-the-basin and-strike on-the-lintel and-the-two-doorposts', Lev 14:4,6,49,51-52 leper-purification 'cedar-wood and-hyssop and-scarlet-yarn', Num 19:6,18 red-heifer-ash-water, 1Kgs 4:33 Solomon-knew from-cedar-to-hyssop, Ps 51:9 'purge-me with-hyssop and-I-shall-be-clean'); concordantly 'hyssop'.
From √azar (to gird); cloth/strap around the loins, fig. intimate-binding (Jer 13); the hyphenated English marks the body-place.

Ps-then-the-waters-would-have-engulfed-us and Ps-then-streams-would-have-passed-over and Ps-then-over-our-soul-would-have-passed (Ps 124:3,4,5). Hyphenated to distinguish the then-back-then-thereafter-poetic-aspect from H227 az 'then-formerly' (already assigned) and H310 achar 'after' (already assigned); poetic-form.
Memorial-portion of grain-offering on the altar (Lev 2:2,9,16; 5:12; 6:15; 24:7; Num 5:26). Hyphenated to preserve memorial-fuel; family with H2142 zakar 'remember'.

Run-out or flow-away of strength or water (Deut 32:36; 1Sam 9:7; Job 14:11; Prov 20:14; Jer 2:36). Hyphenated to distinguish the flow-away-run-out-aspect from H3212 yalakh 'go' and H1980 halakh 'walk-go'.

Original concordant: go-away-depart-leave-aramaic. Aramaic go-away of messenger and king and command (Ezra 4:23; 5:8,15; Dan 2:17,24; 6:19). Hyphenated to distinguish the go-away-depart-aspect from H1946 hakh-aramaic 'go-come-aramaic'; Aramaic cognate without direct Hebrew-equivalent.
Proper noun, meeting-stone Jonathan-David; 1Sam 20:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ezel.
Hiphil: to give the ear to, to listen attentively; the hyphenated English marks the organ-directed action.
Hapax Eccl 12:9 Preacher-pondered-investigates; from H241 ozen ear (denominative).
Digging-stick on belt for army-latrines; Deut 23:13.
Proper noun, city built by Sheerah; 1Chr 7:24; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Uzzen-sheerah.
Proper noun, Naphtali-border-place; Josh 19:34; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aznoth-tabor.
Proper noun, son of Gad; Num 26:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ozni.
Patronym-clan Ozni; Num 26:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Oznite.
Proper noun, father of Levite covenant-signatory; Neh 10:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Azaniah.

Handcuffs or chains - in Jeremiah 40:1 (he was bound in chains amongst all the captives of Jerusalem) and Jeremiah 40:4 (I release you today from the chains that are on your hand); Babylonian war-prisoner-fetters.
Qal: equip oneself or another at the loins with belt/strength; concordantly 'gird'.
From √zarach (to rise); native-born inhabitant as opposed to stranger; the hyphenated English marks status.
Gentilic from the Zerah-clan (1Kgs 5:11 Ethan and Heman wise-men); from H2226 Zerach-stem.
Basic kinship-term; female parallel achot (sister, H269). 'Brother' is the standard equivalent.
The Aramaic designation for brothers in the sense of clan- or covenant-allies - Ezra 7:18 (with your brothers do what seems good to you); Aramaic cognate of H251 ach.

Exclamation of fright or lament - in Ezekiel 6:11 (smite with your hand and stamp with your foot, and say: ah!) and Ezekiel 21:15 (that the heart may melt and the stumblings be multiplied, I have set the terror of the sword at all their gates; ah!); interjection-lamenting, distinguished from H254 ach-fire-pan.

Eze-ah-LORD-LORD and Joel-ah-over-that-day and Eze-ah-I-will-let-myself-be-comforted (Eze 6:11; 21:20; Joel 1:15). Hyphenated to distinguish the woe-ah-exclamation-lament-cry-aspect from H251 ach 'brother' (already assigned) and H253 ach-fire-pan (already assigned); prophetic-lament-cry-form.
Proper noun, son of Abishur; 1Chr 2:29; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahban.
Root 'hd. Cardinal numeral; functions also as indefinite article. 'One' covers both functions; the indefinite-article surface 'a/an' is a render-context shading.

Original concordant: reed-grass-marsh-reed-Nile-grass. Nile-reed-grass at Pharaoh's-cows and meadow-grass-mortal (Gen 41:2,18; Job 8:11). Hyphenated to distinguish the reed-grass-marsh-Nile-grass-aspect from H7070a qaneh 'reed' (already assigned) and H1573 gome 'papyrus-reed' (already assigned); Egyptian-loanword.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head, son of Bela; 1Chr 8:6; concordantly transliterated. Distinguished from H164 Ehud (the judge).
Job asks attention for his utterance; Job 13:17.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head, son of Bela; 1Chr 8:4; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahoah.
Descendant of Ahoah from Benjamin (2Sam 23:9,28; 1Chr 8:4; 11:12,29; 27:4). Gentilic; family with H264 Ahoah.
Proper noun, son of Jahath-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahumai.
Locative/adverbial: what is behind, west, back; concordantly 'behind'.
Qal: grasp and not let go; distinguished from tafas (catch); concordantly 'seize-grasp'.
Proper noun ('he-grasped'); king of Judah; concordantly transliterated.
From √achaz (to grasp/hold); what one grasps/holds in possession, especially landed property; concordantly 'possession'.
Proper noun, priestly father of Amashai; Neh 11:13; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahzai.
Proper noun ('YHWH-has-grasped'); king of Israel and of Judah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, son of Ashur-Tekoa-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahuzzam.
Proper noun, friend of Abimelech; Gen 26:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahuzzath.

1Chr-Ahi-the-son-of-Abdiel-the-son-of-Guni-a-head-of-the-houses-of-the-fathers and 1Chr-and-the-sons-of-Shemer-Ahi-and-Rohgah-Hubbah-and-Aram (1Chr 5:15; 7:34). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ahi-Gad-Asher-tribe-head-Shemer-son-genealogy-aspect from H251 ach-brother (already assigned) as family-form.
Proper noun, son of Benjamin; Gen 46:21; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ehi.

Original concordant: Ahiam-Davids-30-son-Sharar. 2Sam-Ahiam-the-son-of-Sharar-the-Hararite and 1Chr-Ahiam-the-son-of-Sachar-the-Hararite (2Sam 23:33; 1Chr 11:35). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ahiam-David's-30-son-Sharar-aspect from other Ahi-names; family with H251 ach 'brother' (already assigned) - 'mother's-brother'-David's-30-mighty-Hararite-descent.
Aramaic parallel to chidah; riddle-solving Daniel; Dan 5:12.
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-YHWH'); prophet from Shiloh, multiple persons; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahijah.
Proper noun, Asher-leader at land-allotment; Num 34:27; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahihud.
Several Benjamite and Levitical persons (2Sam 6:3,4; 1Chr 8:14,31; 9:37; 13:7). 'His-brother'. English convention: Ahio.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Ehud; 1Chr 8:7; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahihud (Benjamite, distinguished from H282 Ahihud the Asherite).
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-good'); priestly ancestor of Zadok; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Levi-Kohath-branch descendant; 1Chr 6:25; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahimoth.
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-king'); priest at Nob killed by Saul; concordantly transliterated.
Anakite-giant in Hebron and Levitical gate-keeper (Num 13:22; Josh 15:14; Judg 1:10; 1Chr 9:17). English convention: Ahiman. 'Brother-of-the-gift'.
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-vexation'?); son of Zadok, swift runner with the news of Absalom's death; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Manasseh tribe-head son of Shemida; 1Chr 7:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahian.
Proper noun, Solomon's-district-officer Mahanaim; 1Kgs 4:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahinadab.
Gentilic of Ahoah, Benjamite family of David's mighty men (2Sam 23:9,28; 1Chr 8:4; 11:12,29; 27:4). English convention: Ahohite.
Dan tribe-head and David's mighty man (Num 1:12; 2:25; 7:66,71; 10:25; 1Chr 12:3). 'My-brother-is-help'. English convention: Ahiezer.
Proper noun ('my-brother-has-arisen'); son of Shaphan, protector of Jeremiah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, son of Benjamin; Num 26:38; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahiram.
Patronym-clan Ahiram; Num 26:38; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahiramite.
Naphtalite tribe-head at Sinai-numbering (Num 1:15; 2:29; 7:78,83; 10:27). English convention: Ahira. 'My-brother-is-evil'.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Jediael; 1Chr 7:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahishahar.
Proper noun, Solomon's-palace-administrator; 1Kgs 4:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahishar.
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-folly'); David's counsellor, traitor in Absalom's revolt; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Asher-city-not-driven-out; Judg 1:31; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahlab.

1Chr-and-Sheshan-had-a-daughter-her-name-was-Ahlai and 1Chr-Zabad-the-son-of-Ahlai (1Chr 2:31; 11:41). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ahlai-daughter-Sheshan-Jarha-married-father-Attai-Zabad-aspect from other Ach-names; female-proper-noun-heritance.
Gemstone row 3 breastplate; identity-uncertain; Ex 28:19; concordantly transliterated.
Aramaic-proper-noun Persian summer-residence Ecbatana; Ezra 6:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Achmetha.
Qal/Piel: linger, delay, come later; the hyphenated English marks position (distinguished from achar prep 'after').
Root 'hr (to remain behind, to come). Temporal and spatial 'after/behind'. 'After' covers temporal; spatial 'behind' shares the same kernel.
Aramaic parallel to achar; another-king after them; Dan 7:24.
Root 'hr. 'Other' as following/succeeding; related to achar (preposition, H310a).
Proper noun, Benjamin-father of Hushim; 1Chr 7:12; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aher.
Adjective from √achar; what comes at the back in time or space; concordantly 'last'.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Bela; 1Chr 8:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aharah.
Proper noun, son of Harum-Coz-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aharhel.

Aramaic-designation for following-kingdom (Dan 2:39; 7:6,8,20,24). Hyphenated to distinguish the other-following-succeeding-aramaic-aspect from H312 acher 'other-following-Hebrew' (already assigned); Aramaic cognate.
From √achar (behind); what comes last in time/space; the hyphenated English covers 'end' (time) and 'latter-part' (place).
Aramaic end-latter-days (Dan 2:28); cognate Hebrew H319 acharit.

Dan-aramaic-other-kingdom and Dan-aramaic-other-dream and Dan-aramaic-other-ten-horns (Dan 2:11,39,44; 3:29; 7:5,6,8,20,24). Hyphenated to distinguish the other-remaining-aramaic-aspect from Hebrew acher-other (already assigned); Aramaic-cognate-demonstrative.

Behind-the-back-turned-going-back; Noah's sons, Elijah's shadow, Hezekiah's sign (Gen 9:23; 1Sam 4:18; 2Sam 1:22; 2Kgs 20:10,11; Isa 38:8). Direction-adverb, distinguished from H268 achor 'behind-part'.

Original concordant: satrap-empire-governor-Persian-prefect. Persian-province-administrator at Esther and Darius (Esth 3:12; 8:9; 9:3; Ezra 8:36). Hyphenated to distinguish the satrap-governor-aspect from H324 achashdarpan-aramaic 'satrap-aramaic' (already assigned) and H6346 pechah 'governor' (already assigned); Persian loanword 'protector-of-the-realm'.
Old-Persian loanword 'protector-of-the-realm'. Persian provincial administrator (Dan 3:2,3,27; 6:2,3,4,6,7). Aramaic parallel of H323 Hebrew attestation.
Proper noun; Persian king (Xerxes); concordantly transliterated.
Patronym-clan of Ashur-Tekoa-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahashtarite.
The fast royal courier-horses of the Persian post-service - Esther 8:10 (the messengers rode on the swift courier-horses from the royal stud) and 8:14; Persian loanword for racing-horse.
First-sense at; Egyptians consult spirit-mediums; Isa 19:3.
Calmly-without-haste happening of steps or movement (Gen 33:14; 2Sam 18:5; Isa 8:6; Job 15:11). Hyphenated to distinguish the calm-softness-aspect from homonym H328a at-I 'magic-whisper'.
Thorny hedge-plant or buckthorn (Gen 50:10,11; Judg 9:14,15; Ps 58:10). Hyphenated to preserve the dense-spiny-hedge-plant.
Stop ears or lips (1Kgs 6:4; Ps 58:5; Prov 17:28; 21:13; Isa 33:15; Lam 3:8). Hyphenated to preserve the closing-shutting-action.
Judah-ancestor whose clan returned (Ezra 2:16,42; Neh 7:21,45; 10:18). English convention: Ater. 'Left-handed-shut'.

Judg-and-the-children-of-Israel-cried-to-the-LORD-and-the-LORD-raised-up-them-a-deliverer-Ehud-the-son-of-Gera-a-Benjamite-a-man-impeded-of-his-right-hand and Judg-among-all-this-people-were-seven-hundred-chosen-men-impeded-of-their-right-hand (Judg 3:15; 20:16). Hyphenated to preserve the impeded-right-hand-left-handed-aspect; Benjamite-warrior-trait.
Interrogative adverb of place, weak form alongside ayyeh; concordantly 'where-II' (distinguished from ayyeh).

Isa-jackals-shall-cry-in-their-palaces and Isa-desert-howl-wild-dogs and Jer-wild-dogs-in-desolate-places (Isa 13:22; 34:14; Jer 50:39). Hyphenated to distinguish the jackal-desert-wild-dog-howling-creature-aspect from H8577 tannin 'serpent-dragon' and H8568 tannah 'jackal'.
Piece of land surrounded by water, also remote coastal-region; concordantly 'island'.
Unique lexeme. Participle of root 'yb (to be hostile). 'Enemy' standard.

Deep-rooted enmity between parties (Gen 3:15; Num 35:21,22; Eze 25:15; 35:5). Hyphenated to distinguish the structural-enmity-aspect from H8135 sinah 'hatred' (feeling); family with H340 ayav 'be-hostile'.
Disastrous adversity, day of doom; concordantly 'calamity'.

Original concordant: kite-falcon-bird-of-prey-vulture. Unclean-birds-of-prey list and Job-eye-sharp (Lev 11:14; Deut 14:13; Job 28:7). Hyphenated to distinguish the kite-falcon-bird-of-prey-aspect from H5404 nesher 'eagle' (already assigned) and H1772 dayyah 'vulture-kite' and H7201a ra'ah 'bird-of-prey'.
Horite tribe-head and father of Rizpah (Gen 36:24; 2Sam 3:7; 21:8,10,11; 1Chr 1:40). English convention: Aiah.
Interrogative adverb of place; distinguished from efo; concordantly 'where'.
Proper noun; protagonist of Book of Job; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun; Phoenician wife of Ahab; concordantly transliterated.
Lament-cry adverb: 'ah, how!' (opening-word of Lamentations); the hyphenated English marks emotion (distinguished from ech 'how-question').

Intensive-how-question in Esther and Song-of-Songs (Esth 8:6 twice; Song 5:3 twice). Hyphenated to distinguish the how-what-way-aspect from homonyms H349a ech 'how' and H349b echah 'how-lament' (both already assigned).

1S-she-named-the-child-Ichabod-saying-the-glory-is-departed-from-Israel and 1S-Ichabod-the-brother-of-Ahitub-the-son-of-Phinehas (1S 4:21; 14:3). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ichabod-glory-departed-birth-aspect from other names; family with H3519 kavod 'glory'.
Unique lexeme. Male sheep. 'Ram' covers the anatomical and metaphorical (leader). Note: architectural 'pillar' may be context-derived.

Architectural pillar in temple-gate (1Kgs 6:31; Eze 40:9,10,14,16,21,24,26,29,31,33,34,36,37,38,48; 41:1,3). Hyphenated to distinguish the post-pillar-aspect from H5982 ammud 'pillar' and homonym H352a ayil-I 'ram-sheep'.

Leading-ruler or mighty-one in popular-relation (Ex 15:15; 2Kgs 24:15; Eze 17:13; 31:11). Hyphenated to distinguish the leader-noble-aspect from homonyms H352a ayil-I 'ram' and H352b ayil-II 'doorpost-pillar' (already assigned); family with H193 ul.

Isa-you-shall-be-ashamed-of-the-oaks-you-have-desired and Eze-the-rulers-of-the-trees-by-all-waters-which-were-well-watered (Isa 1:29; Eze 31:14 cf). Hyphenated to distinguish the oaks-terebinths-mighty-trees-aspect from H362 Elim 'place-name'.
Male-deer-like-ruminant in-Levitical-food-list distinguished from tsevi (gazelle, H6643) by horn-bearing-aspect (Deut 12:15,22, 14:5, 15:22 food-prescriptions); concordantly 'stag'.
Female deer; Naphtali as released hind, Habakkuk's foot-sure (Gen 49:21; 2Sam 22:34; Job 39:1; Ps 18:34; 22:1; 29:9; Prov 5:19; Jer 14:5; Hab 3:19). Female counterpart of H354 ayyal 'stag'.
Hittite-father-in-law of Esau, Zebulun-descendant and a judge (Gen 26:34; 36:2; 46:14; Num 26:26; Josh 19:43; Judg 12:11,12). English convention: Elon.

Place/valley in Danite inheritance (Josh 10:12 'Sun, stand still over Gibeon; and moon, in valley of Aijalon' Joshua's-miracle during-Amorite-battle, 19:42, 21:24 = 1Chr 6:69 Levitical-city, Judg 1:35 'Amorites-persisted in Aijalon', 12:12 Elon-judicial-burial); concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aijalon.
Solomon-district 1Kgs 4:9 place-name Elon-with-house-Hanan; compound. English convention: Elon-beth-hanan.

Elath-port-city-Red-Sea-recovered-by-Uzziah and Rezin-of-Aram-took-Elath-back (Deut 2:8; 2Kgs 14:22; 16:6). English convention: Elath. Distinguished from possible homonym-related H358 Elot 'tree-place' (if already assigned); family with H352 ayil.

Red-Sea-port-city in Edom-territory (Deut 2:8; 1Kgs 9:26; 2Kgs 14:22; 16:6; 2Chr 26:2). English convention: Eloth. 'Oak-grove'. Distinguished from homonym H359a ayil-oak and from H352 ayil 'ram-oak' (already assigned).
Temple-architecture Eze 40-41 vestibule-portico before sanctuary-door; root uncertain.
Oasis with twelve springs in the wilderness (Ex 15:27; 16:1; Num 33:9,10). English convention: Elim.
Aramaic-equivalent for tree in Nebuchadnezzar's dream (Dan 4:7,8,11,14,17,20,23,26). Hyphenated to mark the Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H352b ayil-II 'doorpost-pillar'.
Proper noun, place at the edge of the wilderness; Gen 14:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: El-paran.

Hab-fearful-dreadful-is-his-judgment and Song-terrible-as-bannered-armies and Song-awesome-as-armies (Hab 1:7; Song 6:4,10). Hyphenated to distinguish the awesome-fearful-dread-aspect from H3372 yare 'fear' (already assigned); concordantly 'awesome-fearful-dread'.
Emim-giant-people and pre-inhabitants-of-Moab (Gen 14:5; Deut 2:10,11). English convention: Emites. 'Terrifying-ones'; family-type with Rephaim and Anakites.
Negative existence-particle. English has no single-word equivalent; 'there-is-no' preserves the existential negation that 'not' (H3808, H408) does not cover.
Interrogative adverb: 'whence?'; the hyphenated English distinguishes from ayin noun 'nothing'.
Proper noun, son of Gilead; Num 26:30; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Iezer.
Patronym-clan Iezer; Num 26:30; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Iezerite.
Dry capacity-measure for grain (about 22 litres); concordantly transliterated.

Interrogative 'where?' - Joseph seeks brothers (Gen 37:16 'where do they pasture?'), Gideon's-brothers (Judg 8:18 'where-are-the-men?'), Saul seeks David-Samuel (1Sam 19:22), David's question about-Mephibosheth (2Sam 9:4), Jeroboam-wife-with-Ahijah (1Kgs 14:2 asked), Aramaeans-Elisha (2Kgs 6:13).
Root 'ysh or 'nsh. Semantically 'individual male being'; female parallel ishshah (H802). Also idiomatically 'each one', 'every'. Distinguished from H120 adam (human, gender-neutral species).

Fourth son Saul who after Saul's-death reigned over eleven tribes in Mahanaim under Abner against David (2Sam 2:8,10,12,15, 3:7-8,14-15, 4:5-12 murdered-in-bed); 'man-of-shame' (originally Ish-Baal in 1Chr 8:33, 9:39, masoretically adjusted); concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, son of Hammoleketh Manasseh-branch; 1Chr 7:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ishhod.
Little-man-in-the-eye, deepest-night (Deut 32:10; Ps 17:8; Prov 7:2,9; 20:20; Lam 2:18). Hyphenated to preserve the pupil-apple-of-eye-aspect; diminutive-family with H376 ish 'man'.
Aramaic-cognate of-Hebrew-H3426 yesh (there-is/existence-particle) distinguished by Aramaic-language-form in-Daniel-and-Ezra (Ezra 4:16, 5:17, 6:9 Persian-administrative; Dan 2:10-11, 3:12,17,29).

Ithiel-Benjamite-tribe-head-post-exile-Nehemiah and Ithiel-Agur-proverb-addressee (Neh 11:7; Prov 30:1 twice). English convention: Ithiel. 'God-is-with-me' or 'God-with-me' (et-with + El-God already assigned).
Proper noun; fourth son of Aaron; concordantly transliterated.
Durable, uninterrupted (always-flowing brook, mighty peoples); the hyphenated English marks the unchanging strength.
Ezrahite wise-man and Levitical singer (1Kgs 5:11; 1Chr 2:6,8; 6:27,32; 15:17,19; Ps 89:1). English convention: Ethan. 'Steadfast'; family with H386 ethan 'enduring-firm'.
Proper noun seventh month (September/October) temple-dedication; 1Kgs 8:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ethanim.
Restrictive/asseverative particle. 'Only' covers the limitation; also asseverative ('verily').
Proper noun, city in Shinar; Gen 10:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Accad.

Deceitful brook or lying-water that dries up in dry seasons - in Jeremiah 15:18 (will You be to me as a deceitful brook, as waters that fail?) and Micah 1:14 (the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel).
Two Judah- and Asher-cities by the Mediterranean (Josh 15:44; 19:29; Judg 1:31; Mic 1:14). English convention: Achzib. 'Deceit-lying'; family with H391 akhzav 'deceitful'.

Merciless enemy or soul-hardness (Deut 32:33; Jer 30:14; 50:42; Prov 5:9). Hyphenated to distinguish the cruel-merciless-aspect from H2555 chamas 'violence' and H394 akhzari 'cruel-merciless' (gentilic-variant).

Cruel-feelingless in action (Job 30:21; Prov 5:9; 11:17; 12:10; 17:11; Jer 6:23; 30:14; 50:42; Lam 4:3). Hyphenated to mark the compassion-less-aspect; family with H393 akzar 'cruel' (nominal-synonym).
Food-strength for 40 days Elijah to Horeb; 1Kgs 19:8.
Proper noun; Philistine king of Gath; concordantly transliterated.
Root 'kl. Derived okel (food, H400), oklah (food, H402). 'Eat' is kernel.
Aramaic 'eat/devour' (Dan 3:8; 4:30; 6:25; 7:5,7,19,23). Concordant via '-aramaic' suffix; family with Hebrew H398 akal.
From √achal (eat); food-object; distinguished from lechem (bread); concordantly 'food'.
Proper noun, presumably disciple of Agur; Prov 30:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ucal.
From √achal (eat); that which is eaten, fodder; concordantly 'fodder' (distinguished from maachal).
Elihu's-urging not heavy on Job; Job 33:7.
Land-cultivator or farmer of fields (Isa 61:5; Jer 14:4; 31:24; 51:23; Joel 1:11; Amos 5:16). Hyphenated to distinguish the farmer-husbandman-aspect from H3009 yagav 'till-land'.
Achshaph-city-king-Jabin-coalition and Asher-border-place (Josh 11:1; 12:20; 19:25). English convention: Achshaph. 'I-am-bewitched' or 'enchantment-place' (family with kashaph-bewitch).
Prohibitive negation (negative imperative). To be distinguished from lo (H3808, absolute negation). 'Not!' with exclamation marks the prohibitive character.

Ezra-aramaic-not-suspend-the-work and Dan-aramaic-not-be-troubled and Dan-aramaic-not-let-countenance-be-changed (Ezra 4:22; 6:8; Dan 2:24). Hyphenated to distinguish the not-aramaic-negation-aspect from H408 al-Hebrew 'not-cohortative' (already assigned).

Root 'wl. Shortened form of eloah/elohim (H433/H430). Concordantly identical: 'Mighty-One' (singular). Preserves concordance via the same English root-form. 'God' is a cultural choice that does not preserve the root-meaning of the Hebrew (strong/mighty).

Demonstrative 'these' (plural); variant alongside H428 elleh in Hebrew. Gen 19:8,25; 26:3,4; Lev 18:27; Deut 4:42; 7:22; 1Chr 20:8. Homonym of H410 El 'Mighty-One' and H413 el 'to'; numbering '-III' per homonym-protocol.

Aramaic demonstrative 'these' plural - Ezra 5:15 (these vessels bring and place them in the temple) and Daniel Aramaic context; distinguished from H1791 dek-aramaic (already assigned) as singular-pointer.
Direction-marking preposition. 'To' preserves the kernel of directed movement; to be distinguished from 'al (H5921a, position-on).
Proper noun, father of Solomon's-district-officer Shimei-Benjamin; 1Kgs 4:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ela.

Eze-I-will-rain-hailstones-fire-sulphur and Eze-hailstones-from-God and Eze-great-hailstones-falling (Eze 13:11,13; 38:22). Hyphenated to distinguish the hailstone-ice-block-large-aspect from H1259 barad 'hail' (already assigned); Ezekiel-exclusive.

Algum-wood-Ophir-temple-construction-Solomon and algum-beams-temple-musicians-instruments and algum-Lebanon-wood-David-stockpile (1Chr 2:8; 9:10,11; 2Chr 9:10,11). Hyphenated to distinguish the algum-precious-wood-sandalwood-Lebanon-wood-aspect from H484 almuggim variant.

Num-and-the-Spirit-rested-on-them-and-they-prophesied-and-Eldad-and-Medad and Num-a-young-man-ran-and-told-Moses-and-said-Eldad-and-Medad-prophesy-in-the-camp (Num 11:26,27). Hyphenated to distinguish the Eldad-seventy-elders-aspect from other names.

Gen-sons-Midian-Abida-Eldaah and 1Chr-sons-Midian-Eldaah (Gen 25:4; 1Chr 1:33). Hyphenated to distinguish the Eldaah-son-Midian-Abraham-grandson-aspect from others; 'God-knows'-theophoric-name-Midian-line.

Place-under-oath with imprecation in covenant or testimony (Judg 17:2; 1Sam 14:24; 1Kgs 8:31; 2Chr 6:22; Hos 4:2; 10:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the imprecating-oath-action from H779 arar 'curse' and H7043 qalal 'curse'; family with H423 alah noun.
Solemnly pronounced oath with self-curse as sanction; concordantly 'imprecation'.
Large deciduous broadleaf tree (Abraham under terebinth, Absalom's hair); the hyphenated English distinguishes from Elah pn.
Proper noun ('terebinth'); king of Israel, father of Hoshea, valley near Socoh; concordantly transliterated.
Aramaic form, equivalent of eloah/elohim. Concordantly identical: 'Mighty-One'.
Aramaic parallel to elleh; idols like-these will-perish; Jer 10:11.

Root 'wl/'lh (to be strong, mighty). Plural form of eloah (H433); shortened el (H410). 'Mighty-One' departs from the root; 'God' is a cultural choice that does not preserve the root. The plural form is held semantically singular when referring to the Ene (pluralis-majestatis); plural-of-actual-gods or plural-of-judges surfaces in render.

Aramaic-deictic 'behold' at dream-visions (Dan 2:31; 4:7,10; 7:8). Hyphenated to distinguish the behold-look-aramaic-aspect from H2005 hen 'behold' (already assigned) and H7200 ra'ah 'see' (already assigned) and H718 aru-aramaic 'see-aramaic'; Aramaic deictic.
Singular of elohim; poetic form (especially Job, Psalms); concordantly 'Mighty-One' (same lexeme as H430/H410).
Jer 14:14 false-prophets-divination-nothing; nothingness-idol cognate with H410 El (negation).
Proper noun, sixth month (Aug/Sept); wall-completion Nehemiah; Neh 6:15; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elul.

Large tree (probably terebinth-pistachio); marker-places for meeting/revelation (Gen 12:6; 13:18; 14:13; 18:1; Deut 11:30; Josh 19:33; Judg 4:11; 9:6,37; 1Sam 10:3). Hyphenated; alongside H437 allon oak.

Sturdy-broadleaf oak, sacred-place-tree (Gen 35:8; Josh 19:33; Isa 2:13; 6:13; 44:14; Eze 27:6; Hos 4:13; Amos 2:9; Zech 11:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the species-specific from H436 elon 'terebinth-tree'.

Original concordant: Allon-border-terebinth-Naphtali. Josh-border-Naphtali-turned-from-Heleph-from-Oak-in-Zaanannim-and-Adami-Hannekeb-and-Jabneel-to-Lakkum-going-out-at-the-Jordan and Judg-Heber-the-Kenite-separated-from-Cain-pitched-his-tent-as-far-as-the-Oak-of-Zaanannim-which-is-by-Kedesh (Josh 19:33; Judg 4:11 cf). Hyphenated.
Proper noun ('oak-of-weeping') burial-place of Deborah; Gen 35:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Allon-bacuth.
Patronym-clan son of Zebulun; Num 26:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elonite.

Intimate friend; also metaphorically of YHWH as youth-friend (Ps 55:14; Prov 2:17; 16:28; 17:9; Jer 3:4; 11:19; 13:21; Mic 7:5). Hyphenated to distinguish the intimate-closeness-aspect from H7453 rea 'companion' (general).
Leader/clan-chief (especially Edom-genealogies); distinguished from alluf I (intimate); concordantly 'chieftain'.

Num-they-departed-from-Dophkah-and-encamped-in-Alush and Num-they-departed-from-Alush-and-encamped-in-Rephidim (Num 33:13,14). Hyphenated to distinguish the Alush-stop-wilderness-Sin-aspect from other stops; wilderness-journey-Sinai-Rephidim-route-Num-33-itinerary.

All-people-become-corrupt and Ps-all-of-humanity-spoiled and Job-loathsome-become (Job 15:16; Ps 14:3; 53:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the become-corrupt-spoil-aspect from H7843 shachath 'corrupt-make' (already assigned).

David's mighty man who killed a giant and son of Dodo (2Sam 21:19; 23:24; 1Chr 11:26; 20:5). English convention: Elhanan. 'God-is-gracious'; family with H2603a chanan 'be-gracious' (already assigned).
Proper noun ('my-God-is-Father'); among others eldest brother of David; concordantly transliterated.

Theophoric-name 'my-Mighty-One is El' - several persons: Manasseh-half head of-clans in-Bashan (1Chr 5:24), Kohath-Levite priest (1Chr 6:34), Benjamite (1Chr 8:20,22), David's-mighty-men (1Chr 11:46-47 twice), Gadite-David-supporter (1Chr 12:11).
Proper noun, Benjamin-leader at land-allotment; Num 34:21; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elidad.
David's son and Aramean-prince and Judah-commander (2Sam 5:16; 1Kgs 11:23; 1Chr 3:8; 2Chr 17:17). English convention: Eliada. 'God-knows'; family with H3045 yada 'know'.
Fat-tail-portion of consecrated ram for altar (Ex 29:22; Lev 3:9; 7:3; 8:25; 9:19). Not hyphenated; fat-tail-sheep-tail as technical offering-portion.
Proper noun ('my El is YHWH'); prophet; concordantly transliterated.

Fourth Job-speaker, son of Barachel the Buzite (Job 32:2,4,5,6, 34:1, 35:1, 36:1); also Samuel's ancestor Zuph-Ephraimite (1Sam 1:1), Manassite David-supporter (1Chr 12:20), Korahite gatekeeper (1Chr 26:7), David's brother in genealogy (1Chr 27:18).
A Korahite gatekeeper under Obed-Edom in David's time - 1Chronicles 26:3; disambiguated from a returnee with the same root-name Elioenai (H454b).
Various post-exilic descendants-heads (1Chr 3:23,24; 4:36; 7:8; 26:3; Ezra 8:4; 10:22,27; Neh 12:41). 'Toward-YHWH-are-my-eyes'. English convention: Elioenai.
Solomon-scribe 1Kgs 4:3, brother of Ahijah, son of Shisha; theophoric proper noun (El-).
Husband of Naomi in book of Ruth (Ruth 1:2,3; 2:1,3; 4:3,9). 'My-God-is-king'. English convention: Elimelech.

Aramaic-demonstrative 'these' for kings and images (Ezra 4:21; 5:15; 6:8; Dan 6:6,24; 7:17). Hyphenated to distinguish the these-mentioned-aramaic-aspect from H428 elleh 'these' (already assigned) and H411 el-III 'these-pointing' (already assigned).
Gad- and Levitical tribe-head (Num 1:14; 2:14; 3:24; 7:42,47; 10:20). 'God-has-added'. English convention: Eliasaph.
Proper noun ('my-God-is-help'); Abraham's servant from Damascus, son of Moses, multiple persons; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Benjamin-son of Shimei; 1Chr 8:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elienai.
Proper noun, father of Bathsheba; 2Sam 11:3; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eliam.
Proper noun ('God-is-gold'); son of Esau and a friend of Job from Teman; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, David's-warrior son of Ur; 1Chr 11:35; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eliphal.
Son of David and other Davidites (2Sam 5:16; 23:34; 1Chr 3:6,8; 8:39; 14:7; Ezra 8:13; 10:33). 'My-God-is-deliverance'. English convention: Eliphelet.
Reubenite tribe-head at Sinai-numbering (Num 1:5; 2:10; 7:30,35; 10:18). English convention: Elizur. 'My-God-is-rock'.
Levite and Zebulonite-leader (Ex 6:22; Lev 10:4; Num 3:30; 34:25; 1Chr 15:8; 2Chr 29:13). 'God-has-hidden'. English convention: Elizaphan.
Proper noun, David's-warrior Harodite; 2Sam 23:25; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elika.

Steward of Hezekiah, participant Rabshakeh-negotiations (2Kgs 18:18,26,37, 19:2, Isa 22:20 YHWH-chosen-servant, 36:3,11,22, 37:2); also original name of king Jehoiakim before Pharaoh-Necho renamed him (2Kgs 23:34, 2Chr 36:4); priest-Neh-12.
Proper noun, wife of Aaron; Ex 6:23; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elisheba.
Elishah-son-of-Javan and Tyre-trade-partner (Gen 10:4; 1Chr 1:7; Eze 27:7). English convention: Elishah-people-son. Distinguished from prophet-H477 Elisha (already assigned). 'God-is-salvation'.
Proper noun ('God-restores'); high priest in Nehemiah's time, and several others; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun ('God-has-heard'); various persons (prince of Ephraim, priests, scribe of Jeremiah); concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun ('El has saved'); prophet, successor of Elijah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, captain in Jehoiada's-revolt against Athaliah; 2Chr 23:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elishaphat.
Aramaic demonstrative pronoun pl: these, those (Dan/Ezra); the hyphenated English marks language and number.

The deep lament of the afflicted - Job 10:15 (and woe to me, for if I am righteous, I shall not lift up my head) and Micah 7:1 (woe to me, for it goes with me as with the gatherings of the summer-fruits).

Niphal/Piel: by-shock-or-command-become-speechless distinguished from charash (be-silent, H2790b) and chashah (keep-quiet, H2814) by the sudden-speechlessness-aspect (Gen 37:7 Joseph's-dream 'we-were-becoming-mute-of-sheaves in-the-midst-of-field').
Psalm-title Ps 16, 56-60 miktam-designation; possibly inscription or golden-saying.
Not-able-to-speak, of person or image (Ex 4:11; Ps 38:14; 39:3,10; Prov 31:8; Isa 35:6; 56:10; Hab 2:18). Hyphenated to preserve the speech-impeded-state.

Hiram-shipments-sandalwood-Ophir and temple-stairs-and-harps-lyres (1Kgs 10:11,12). Hyphenated to distinguish the sandalwood-algum-precious-wood-aspect from H730 erez 'cedar' (already assigned) and H1265 berosh 'cypress-juniper' (already assigned).
Bound sheaf of harvest (Gen 37:7; Ps 126:6). Hyphenated to distinguish the bound-sheaf-aspect from H6016b omer-II 'grain-sheaf' (loose garve).

Original concordant: Alvan-son-Shobal-Horite-Seir. Gen-sons-Shobal-Alvan-Manahath-Ebal-Shepho and 1Chr-sons-Shobal-Alian-Manahath (Gen 36:23; 1Chr 1:40). Hyphenated; Edomite-autochthonous-Horite-genealogy.
Proper noun, Asher-city; Josh 19:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Allammelech.
Woman whose husband has died; social category in legal texts; concordantly 'widow'.
State-of-widowhood and mourning-attire (Gen 38:14,19; Isa 54:4; 2Sam 20:3). Hyphenated; family with H490 almanah 'widow'.

Original concordant: unnamed-no-name-not-by-name. Boaz-addresses-unknown-redeemer and David-place-encampment-such-and-such (Ruth 4:1; 1Sam 21:3; 2Kgs 6:8). Hyphenated to distinguish the unnamed-no-name-aspect; forms pair peloni-almoni 'such-and-such'.
Proper noun, father of David's-warriors Jeribai/Joshaviah; 1Chr 11:46; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elnaam.
Grandfather of Jeconiah and emissary in Jehoiakim's time (2Kgs 24:8; Jer 26:22; 36:12,25; Ezra 8:16). 'God-has-given'. English convention: Elnathan.
Original concordant: Ellasar-kingdom-east-coalition. Gen-Arioch-king-Ellasar and Gen-same-coalition-repetition (Gen 14:1,9). Hyphenated; possibly-Larsa-South-Mesopotamia-small-kingdom.
Proper noun, Ephraim-son killed by men of Gath; 1Chr 7:21; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elead.
Proper noun, Ephraim-tribe-head; 1Chr 7:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eladah.
Proper noun, Benjamite David's-warrior Ziklag; 1Chr 12:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eluzai.
Proper noun ('El has helped'); priest-son of Aaron; concordantly transliterated.
Moabite city in Reuben's inheritance (Num 32:3,37; Isa 15:4; 16:9; Jer 48:34). English convention: Elealeh. 'God-has-exalted-himself'.
Post-exilic Levite and several persons (1Chr 2:39,40; 8:37; 9:43; Ezra 10:22; Jer 29:3). 'God-has-made'. English convention: Elasah.

Instruction-teaching to Job and wisdom-learning (Job 15:5; 33:33; 35:11; Prov 22:25). Hyphenated to distinguish the teach-instruct-aspect from homonym H5968 alaf 'faint' (already assigned) and H3925 lamad 'teach' (already assigned).
Hiphil-participle; our-flocks thousand-fold in stalls; Ps 144:13.

Homonym of H505 'thousand': tribal sub-unit (Num 1:16; 10:4,36; Josh 22:14,21,30; Judg 6:15; 1Sam 10:19,21; 23:23; Mic 5:1). Hyphenated via '-II' to maintain distinction with H505 semantically and numerically.
Aramaic-equivalent for number-thousand (Dan 5:1; 7:10; Ezra 6:17). Hyphenated to mark the Aramaic-parallel; family with H505 elef 'thousand' (Hebrew).
Proper noun, Benjamin-city; Josh 18:28; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eleph.

Elpaal-Benjamite-tribe-head-son-of-Hushim and Elpaal-builder-of-Ono-and-Lod and Elpaal-Beriah-father (1Chr 8:11,12,18). English convention: Elpaal. 'God-works' or 'God-makes' (El-God + pa'al-work already assigned).
Piel; Delilah pressed Samson daily; Judg 16:16.
Proper noun ('God-has-acquired'); father of Samuel and several Levites; concordantly transliterated.
Patronym-clan inhabitant of Elkosh; Nah 1:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elkoshite.

Original concordant: Eltolad-city-Judah-south-Simeon. Josh-Eltolad-Chesil-Hormah and Josh-and-the-inheritance-of-the-sons-of-Simeon-was-in-the-midst-of-the-inheritance-of-the-sons-of-Judah-Beersheba-Sheba-Moladah-Hazar-shual-Balah-Ezem-Eltolad (Josh 15:30; 19:4). Hyphenated.
Proper noun, Judah-hill-country-city; Josh 15:59; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eltekon.
Psalms-title-designation (Ps 46:1, 1Chr 15:20); from H5959 alma virgin, possibly high-voice-choir.
Conditional conjunction. 'If' covers hypothetical; assertive function (oath-formula 'if...!') shares the same conditional kernel.
Variant of H518a. Concordantly 'unless'. Audit 2026-04-26: distinguishing from H518a conditional 'if'. Cluster with H3588b in ki-im combination.
Female slave of higher status than shifchah; concordantly 'maidservant'.
Length-unit (forearm). 'Cubit' is the English traditional length-measure-equivalent; 'elbow-measure' would be too verbal.

Original concordant: cubit-measure-length-aramaic. Aramaic-cubit-measure of temple-dimensions (Ezra 6:3 twice; Dan 3:1 twice). Hyphenated to distinguish the cubit-measure-aspect from H520a ammah 'cubit' (already assigned); Aramaic cognate.
Proper noun, hill where Joab pursued Abner; 2Sam 2:24; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ammah.

Ishmael-tribes and praise-YHWH-all-tribes (Gen 25:16; Num 25:15; Ps 117:1). Hyphenated to distinguish the tribe-nation-people-clan-aspect from homonym H5980 ummah 'beside' (already assigned) and H1471a goy 'people' (already assigned) and H5971a am 'people'.
Aramaic 'people-community/nation' (Dan 3:4,7,29; 5:19; 6:26; 7:14). Concordant via '-aramaic' suffix; family with Hebrew H523 ummah.
Wisdom was master-worker beside God; Prov 8:30.
Proper noun ('faithful'); king of Judah and a governor; concordantly transliterated.

Original concordant: proper-name-city-god-Amon-No. Proper noun Amon, the Egyptian city-god of No (Thebes) - in Jeremiah 46:25 (I will punish Amon of No) and Nahum 3:8 (are you better than No-amon which lay among the rivers?); sun-god-state-cult of Thebes.

Original concordant: faithfulness-firmness-trustworthy. God's-faithfulness or trustworthy-people (Deut 32:20; Prov 13:17; 20:6; Isa 26:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the faithfulness-firmness-aspect from H530 emunah 'faithfulness' (already assigned); family with H539 aman 'be-firm'.
Proper noun; father of prophet Isaiah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, father of Solomon's-servants-clan returnees; Ezra 2:57; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ami.

Brave-firm of heart or horse (2Sam 15:12; 2Chr 13:18; 17:7 (?); Job 9:4,19; Isa 28:2; 40:26; Amos 2:16). Hyphenated to distinguish the firm-resolute-strength from H1368 gibbor 'strong-mighty', H5797 oz 'strength' and H2389 chazaq 'strong'; family with H553 amets.

The treetop or summit-branch as the uppermost point - in Isaiah 17:6 (two or three berries in the top) and Isaiah 17:9 (in that day his strong cities shall be as a forsaken bough and as the topmost branch); related to amar (announce, prominent).
Qal/Pulal: pine away, wither (agriculture, people); the hyphenated English marks weakening.
Proper noun, Judah-city south; Josh 15:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Amam.
Root 'mn. Stem-related emet (faithfulness, H571). Hiphil: hold-firm, trust. 'Believe' preserves the trust-dimension; shares with batach (H982) semantically but etymologically distinct.
