Hena-Assyrian-conquered-city which-Rabshakeh-mentions (2Kgs 18:34; 19:13; Isa 37:13). English convention: Hena. Assyrian-toponym of uncertain-origin-possibly 'Anat'.

Exclamation/gesture for silence-call (Num 13:30; Judg 3:19; Neh 8:11; Amos 6:10; 8:3; Hab 2:20; Zeph 1:7; Zech 2:17). Hyphenated; distinguishes imperative 'shh!'-action from H2814 chashah 'be-silent'.

Reversal or perversion - in Isaiah 29:16 (you turners of things upside down, shall the potter be esteemed as the clay?) and Ezekiel 16:34 (it is reversed with you, contrary to women); from H2015 hafakh.
Enemy-equipment of shields and chariots; Eze 23:24.
Mount Hor (death-place of Aaron Num 20:22, Num 33); also northern border-mountain Num 34:7; concordantly transliterated as place-name.
Proper noun, place where eastern-tribes were carried away; 1Chr 5:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hara.
Hapax Eze 43:15 burnt-offering-altar-top; compound har-El mountain-of-God or fire-hearth.
Root hrg. 'Slay' standard; distinguished from mut (dying-process, H4191).
Mass-murder or slaughter-work in judgment (Esth 9:5; Isa 27:7; 30:25; Prov 24:11; Zech 11:4,7). Hyphenated to distinguish slaughter-killing-aspect from H2028 haregah and H7524 retsach 'murder'.
Place of death-slaughter as judgment-image (Jer 7:32; 12:3; 19:6; Zech 11:4,7). Hyphenated to distinguish slaughter-place-aspect from H2027 hereg and H2873 tavach.
Qal: be impregnated, conceive; the hyphenated English marks physical aspect.
Active-adjective 'with-child' (Gen 16:11, 38:24-25, Ex 21:22, Judg 13:5,7, 1Sam 4:19, 2Sam 11:5, 2Kgs 8:12, 15:16, Isa 7:14, 26:17, Jer 20:17, 31:8, Hos 13:16, Amos 1:13); concordantly 'pregnant'.
Aramaic for visions-thoughts on bed; Dan 4:5.
Gen-multiply-conception-and-sorrow and Hos-from-bearing-and-from-womb-and-from-conception and Ruth-LORD-gave-conception (Gen 3:16; Hos 9:11; Ruth 4:13). Hyphenated.
Patronym-clan David's-warrior Shammoth; 1Chr 11:27; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hararite.
Proper noun, king of Gezer; Josh 10:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Horam.
Proper noun, father of Aharhel-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Harum.
Proper noun, place where people-were cast away; Amos 4:3; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Harmon.
Brother of Abram, father of Lot (Gen 11:26,27,28,29,31; 1Chr 2:46; 23:9). English convention: Haran.
Qal: pull down, overthrow, destroy; concordantly 'break-down'.
Proper noun ('destruction-city') Egypt-city; Isa 19:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Heres.
Poetic/extended noun-form of har (H2022); distributes in Ps, Song, prophets (Ps 30:8, 87:1, 133:3); concordantly identical 'mountain' - morphological variant does not break concordance.
Mountain-dweller-family of David's mighty men (2Sam 23:11,33; 1Chr 11:34,35). Gentilic. 'Mountain-dweller'.
Proper noun, David's-warrior Gizonite; 1Chr 11:34; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hashem.
Persian-eunuch messenger between Esther and Mordecai (Esth 4:5,6,9,10). English convention: Hathach. 'Verily-decided'.
Piel; Elijah mocks Baal-prophets ('he is musing, on a journey...'); 1Kgs 18:27.

Second homonym distinguished from hatal-I; Piel/Pual: mockingly-deceive-by-false-promises-or-words distinguished from ramah (deceive) and natal (defraud) by mockery-aspect (Gen 31:7 Jacob-to-Laban, Ex 8:29, Judg 16:10,13,15, Job 13:9, Isa 44:20, Jer 9:5).
Proper noun trading-people with Tyre; Eze 27:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vedan.
Proper noun, place in war-book; Num 21:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vaheb.
Metal hook/peg from which tabernacle-curtains hang; concordantly 'hook'.
Proper noun, tenth son of Haman; Esth 9:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vajezatha.
Proper noun, son of Bani who took foreign-wife; Ezra 10:36; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vaniah.
Proper noun, father of Nahbi; Num 13:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vophsi.
Proper noun, son of Samuel; 1Chr 6:28; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vashni.
Queen of Ahasuerus who-refused to-appear-before-his-guests and-was-deposed in favour-of Esther (Esth 1:9,11-12,15-17,19, 2:1,4,17). English convention: Vashti.
Steppe-wolf as image of rapacity (Gen 49:27; Isa 11:6; 65:25; Jer 5:6; Eze 22:27; Hab 1:8; Zeph 3:3). English convention: wolf.
Midianite prince killed at the Wolf-press (Judg 7:25; 8:3; Ps 83:12). 'Wolf'. English convention: Zeeb.
Demonstrative feminine, counterpart of zeh (H2088). 'This' identical to masculine; context disambiguates.
Several persons of the same name: Judah-descent, Ephraimite, murderer of Joash (1Chr 2:36,37; 7:21; 11:41; 2Chr 24:26; Ezra 10:27,33,43). From zavad 'bestow'. English convention: Zabad.
Judah-ancestor of Achan and other persons (Josh 7:1,17,18; 1Chr 8:19; 27:27; Neh 11:17). 'My-gift'. English convention: Zabdi.
Several-persons: Benjamite-archer who-came-to-David in-Ziklag (1Chr 12:7); Korahite gatekeeper, judge under Jehoshaphat, post-exilic priest. English convention: Zebadiah. 'YHWH-has-bestowed'.
Proper noun, priest of Solomon son of Nathan; 1Kgs 4:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zabud.
Proper noun, return with Ezra (not Solomon's-priest H2071); Ezra 8:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zabud.
Exalted divine dwelling-house in heavens (1Kgs 8:13; 2Chr 6:2; Isa 63:15; Hab 3:11; Ps 49:15). Hyphenated to distinguish exalted-house-aspect from H4583 ma'on 'dwelling'; family with H2082 zaval.
Proper noun (son/tribe of Israel); concordantly transliterated.
Zebulonite tribe-member at census and army-organisation (Num 26:27; Judg 12:11,12). English convention: Zebulonite. Family-with H2074 Zevulun (already assigned); tribal-adjective.
Root zbh. 'Sacrifice' preserves the offer-slaughter-action; derived zevach (H2077).

Root zbh (slaughter, sacrifice, H2076). Zevach = slaughtered offering. 'Slaughter-offering' preserves the root-relation with the slaughter-action; 'sacrifice' is broader, 'meal-offering' is context-splinter.
Midianite king defeated by Gideon (Judg 8:5-21, Ps 83:12); concordantly transliterated. Homonym with zevach 'slaughter-offering' (H2077) distinguished by proper-noun-status.
Proper noun, son of Bebai who took foreign-wife; Ezra 10:28; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zabbai.
Proper noun, son of Nebo who took foreign-wife; Ezra 10:43; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zebina.
Governor of Abimelech in Shechem (Judg 9:28,30,36,38,41). 'Exalted-dwelling'. English convention: Zebul.
Aramaic buy-acquire-for-self (Dan 2:8 buy-time); cognate Hebrew √zvn absent.
From zud 'swell-boil'. Person-designation of the insolent (Ps 119:21,51,69; Mal 3:15). Hyphenated to distinguish from H2087 zadon 'insolence' (abstract).

Arrogant-deliberate-sin against better knowing (Deut 17:12 'who acts with zadon', 1Sam 17:28 Eliab's reproach to David, Prov 11:2 shame-follows, 13:10 strife-from, 21:24, Jer 49:16 Edom, 50:29,31-32 Babel).
Demonstrative masculine. Female parallel zot (H2063). 'This' is the standard translation.
Demonstrative pronoun feminine singular (Judg 18:4; 1Kgs 14:5; 2Kgs 6:19; Eze 40:45; Ps 132:14). Hyphenated to preserve feminine-variant-aspect; family with H2063 zoth 'this' (standard).
Proper noun, son of Rehoboam + Mahalath; 2Chr 11:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zaham.
Hiphil: instruct someone by warning; distinguished from zahar I 'shine'; concordantly 'warn'.

Brightness or radiating clarity - in Ezekiel 8:2 (looked like the appearance of fire, like the appearance of brightness) and Daniel 12:3 (they shall shine as the brightness of the firmament); heavenly light.
Demonstrative/relative pron (poetic, especially Psalms): this, which; the hyphenated English marks relative-function.
Qal: stream, flow forth; used for milk and honey, and for body-discharges; concordantly 'flow'.
From √zuv (flow); abnormal body-outflow (Lev 15), makes unclean; concordantly 'discharge'.
Qal/Hiphil: deliberately-defiantly-act against-authority distinguished from ga'ah (be-haughty) and anaph (be-angry) by presumption-aspect; originally 'boil/seethe' metaphorically-used.
Proper noun people defeated by Chedorlaomer; Gen 14:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zuzim.
Proper noun, son of Ishi-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zoheth.

Corner-pillar or cornerstone as adornment of buildings - in Psalm 144:12 (our daughters as corner-pillars carved after the similitude of a palace) and Zechariah 9:15 (they shall be filled like the basins).

Squander or lightly throw out - in Isaiah 46:6 (they squander gold out of the bag and weigh silver in the balance) and Lamentations 1:8 (therefore she has become unclean; all that honoured her despise her).
Separating preposition: except, with the exception of; concordantly 'besides'.
Aramaic Hithpeel; all-flesh-fed by Nebuchadnezzar-tree; Dan 4:12.
Tremble and quake from fear - in Esther 5:9 (he did not stand up nor move for him) and Ecclesiastes 12:3 (in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble); the motion of dismay before God.
Aramaic-tremble of peoples before God-of-Daniel (Dan 5:19; 6:27). Hyphenated to distinguish tremble-shake-aramaic-aspect from H7493 ra'ash 'tremble' (already assigned) and H2729 charad.
Great shudder which befalls peoples (Deut 28:25; 2Chr 29:8; Jer 15:4; 24:9; 29:18; 34:17; Eze 23:46). Hyphenated; family with H2112 zua-aramaic 'tremble-aramaic'.
Qal: be strange/different, deviate; partic. zar = stranger/unauthorised; root-form 'be-strange'.
Second-sense zur; Job's-breath became strange to his wife; Job 19:17.

Gideon-wring-dew-out-of-fleece and Job-egg-crushing and Isaiah-wound-press-out (Judg 6:38; Job 39:15; Isa 1:6). Hyphenated to distinguish press-out-wring-out-aspect from homonym H2114 zur 'be-strange'.
Proper noun, son of Jonathan-Jerahmeel-branch; 1Chr 2:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zaza.
Ex-that-the-breastplate-be-not-loosed-from-the-ephod and Ex-so-shall-the-breastplate-not-be-loosed (Ex 28:28; 39:21). Hyphenated to distinguish be-loosed-shift-aspect from other-motion-terms.
Second-sense zachal; Elihu held himself back from awe for age; Job 32:6.
Proper noun ('serpent-stone') Adonijah-feast-place; 1Kgs 1:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: En-rogel/Zoheleth.
Aramaic-equivalent for radiance of royal countenance (Dan 2:31; 4:33; 5:6,9,10; 7:28). Hyphenated to mark Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H2099 ziv 'splendour-bloom'.
God: 'all that moves on fields is mine'; Ps 50:11.
Second-sense ziz; refresh with Zion's-abundance-breast; Isa 66:11.
Proper noun, Levi tribe-head variant Zina; 1Chr 23:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zizah.
Proper noun, Levi tribe-head Gershon-branch; 1Chr 23:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zina.
Proper noun, Gad tribe-head; 1Chr 5:13; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zia.
Place-name in Judah-wilderness where David-hid from Saul (Josh 15:24,55, 1Sam 23:14-15,24, 26:1-2 Ziphites-betray David to-Saul); concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, son of Jehallelel-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ziphah.

Original concordant: Ziphim-inhabitants-Ziph-betrayers. 1S-the-Ziphites-came-up-to-Saul-to-Gibeah-saying-does-not-David-hide-himself-with-us and Ps-when-the-Ziphites-came-and-said-to-Saul-does-not-David-hide-himself-with-us (1S 23:19; Ps 54-title). Hyphenated.

Original concordant: burning-arrows-fetters-sparks-chains. Ps-burning-arrows-of-God's-judgment and Prov-fool-throwing-fire-brands and Isa-burning-iron-fetters (Ps 7:14; Prov 26:18; Isa 50:11). Hyphenated.
Iron-bonds for prisoners and kings (Ps 149:8; Isa 45:14; Nah 3:10; Job 36:8). Hyphenated to distinguish chains-fetters-aspect from homonym H2131a ziqq-I 'fire-arrow-spark' (already assigned).
Olea europaea, tree and fruit; olive-oil central in cult and household; concordantly 'olive'.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Becher; 1Chr 7:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zethan.
Adjective of pure-unmixed quality; pure olive-oil for menorah (Ex 27:20, Lev 24:2), pure incense (Ex 30:34, Lev 24:7), moral unmixedness (Job 8:6, 11:4, 15:15 heavens not zakh, 16:17, 25:5).
Morally transparent-pure-be (Job 15:14; 25:4; Ps 51:6; 73:13; 119:9; Prov 20:9; Isa 1:16; Mic 6:11). Hyphenated to distinguish transparent-pure from H2891 taher 'be-clean' (cultic-ritual).
Aramaic for innocence-found before God; Dan 6:22.
Men-of-people called-together for feast (Ex 23:17; 34:23; Deut 16:16; 20:13). Hyphenated to distinguish male-circle-aspect from H2145 zakhar 'male' and H376 ish 'man'.
Several-persons in-Second-temple-time and-David-time: father-of-Shammua spy-of-Reuben (Num 13:4); Merarite-Levite (1Chr 24:27); Asaphite-singer (1Chr 25:2,10; Neh 12:35); covenant-signer (Neh 10:12).
Head of a family of 760 returnees with Zerubbabel - Ezra 2:9, Nehemiah 7:14.
Pure-clean be of heart, wool or angels (Job 15:15; 25:5; Lam 4:7; Job 9:30). Hyphenated to distinguish pure-glitter-aspect from H2891 taher 'be-clean' and H1305 barar 'purify'.
Root zkr. 'Remember' covers the active recalling that lies in zakar; 'recall' is more passive.
From √zachar (remember); lasting name or mention; concordantly 'remembrance'.
Proper noun, Benjamin-son Jeiel Gibeon; 1Chr 8:31; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zecher.
Root zkr (remember, H2142). Homographic noun: 'male' (memory-bearer). 'Male' preserves the gender-designation.
From √zachar (remember); deliberately lasting sign or feast of remembrance; concordantly 'memorial'.

Several persons: Levitical Korahite (Ex 6:21), Benjamites (1Chr 8:19,23,27, 9:15, 26:25, 27:16), Reubenite-prince (1Chr 27:16), Ephraimite hero (2Chr 28:7), father of Amasiah under Jehoshaphat (2Chr 17:16).
Proper noun ('YHWH-has-remembered'); prophet and several persons; concordantly transliterated.
The prophet Zechariah, son of Berechiah, grandson of Iddo - Ezra 5:1, 6:14, in the Aramaic context of the rebuilding; disambiguated from numerous other Zechariahs and H2148a.
YHWH shall-prune branching-twigs before harvest; Isa 18:5.
Over-eating and revelry with wine-drinker (Deut 21:20; Prov 23:20,21; 28:7). Hyphenated to distinguish glutton-greedy-aspect from homonym H2151a zalal-I 'shake' and H5435 sove 'wine-drinker'.
The burning anger-wind as judgment - Psalm 11:6 (fire and brimstone and a horrible tempest shall be the portion of their cup) and 119:53 (a horror has taken hold upon me because of the wicked).
Leah's slave-concubine, mother of Gad and Asher (Gen 29:24; 30:9,10,12; 35:26; 37:2; 46:18). English convention: Zilpah.
Lev-blood-relatives-incest-abomination and Eze-sword-for-shameful-deeds and Judg-shameful-deed-with-guest (Lev 18:17; 19:29; Judg 20:6; Eze 22:9). Hyphenated.

Grape-tendril or cut-off-branch (Num 13:23; Isa 17:10; Eze 8:17; 15:2; Nah 2:3). Hyphenated to distinguish branch-tendril-aspect from H5189 netishah 'tendril' and H7976 shilluchah 'shoot'; family with H2168.
Proper noun giant-people Ammon-territory; Deut 2:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zamzummim.
Sung songs for praise (2Sam 22:1; 23:1; Job 35:10; Ps 95:2; 119:54; Isa 24:16; 25:5). Hyphenated to distinguish praise-songs-aspect from H7892 shir 'song' and H4210 mizmor 'psalm'.
Singing-time has come turtle-dove heard; Song 2:12.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Becher; 1Chr 7:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zemirah.
Qal: deliberately plan, plot against someone (devise evil, YHWH had purposed); concordantly 'plot'.
Appointed-times and to-the-king-to-tell-set-time (Ezra 10:14; Neh 10:35; 13:31). Hyphenated to distinguish appoint-set-time-aspect from H6942 qadash 'sanctify-set-apart'.
Esther-appointed-Purim-day and Ecclesiastes-everything-has-its-set-time and Nehemiah-set-times-for-offering (Esth 9:27,31; Eccl 3:1; Neh 10:35; 13:31). Hyphenated.
Aramaic 'agreed/set period'; Ezra 5:3 'how long?', Dan 2:16,21 'times change', 3:7-8 'at-that-time', 4:36, 6:10,13 'three times-times per day', 7:12,22,25 'time-times-half-time'.
Piel: play with musical instrument and sing; cult-praise; the hyphenated English marks cultic action.
Vineyard-prune-Sabbath-forbidden and vineyard-care (Lev 25:3,4; Isa 5:6). Hyphenated to distinguish prune-vine-trim-aspect from homonym H2167 zamar 'make-music-sing' (already assigned).

Original concordant: music-string-music-singing-aramaic. Aramaic-music-ensemble at statue-inauguration (Dan 3:5,7,10,15). Hyphenated to distinguish music-string-music-aramaic-aspect from H2172 zimrah 'song-singing' and H4210 mizmor.
Aramaic parallel to Hebrew zammar; temple-choir-singer; Ezra 7:24.
Psalm-singing for YHWH and instrument-music (Ps 81:3; 98:5; Amos 5:23; Isa 51:3). Hyphenated to distinguish song-music-aspect from H7892 shir 'song' (already assigned) and H4210 mizmor.
Proper noun ('my-praise-song'); Simeonite who was thrust through by Phinehas, king Zimri of Israel; concordantly transliterated (distinguished from zimri II tribe-name).
Proper noun, people-destined-for-Babel's-cup; Jer 25:25; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zimri.
YHWH-my-strength-and-my-song in exodus-song and restoration-song (Ex 15:2; Ps 118:14; Isa 12:2). Hyphenated to distinguish strength-song-aspect from H2172 zimrah 'song-music'.
Ps-cattle-of-every-kind-wealth and Ecclesiastes-all-kinds-of-pleasure-gardens-Solomon (Ps 144:13; 2Chr 16:14; Eccl 2:5). Hyphenated to distinguish kind-class-variety-aspect from H4327a min 'kind'.
Aramaic-designation for 'all-kinds-of' music and all kinds of plants (Dan 3:5,7,10,15). Hyphenated to distinguish kind-sort-aramaic-aspect from H4327 min 'kind' (already assigned); Aramaic loan.
Rear-protrusion of animal; serpent in Moses' hand (Ex 4:4), foxes-tails (Judg 15:4), metaphorically 'tail' of people = inferior role (Deut 28:13,44, Isa 9:13-14, 19:15), smoking firebrands (Isa 7:4).
Root znh. Sexual unfaithfulness, also figuratively idolatry. 'Play-the-harlot' preserves the unfaithfulness-kernel; standard concordant.
Two Judah-cities in lowland and hill-country (Josh 15:34,56; 1Chr 4:18; Neh 3:13; 11:30). English convention: Zanoah. 'Rejected-place'; family with H2186 zanach 'reject'.
Plural-abstract of zanah (play-harlot, H2181); iterative-collective acts-of-faithlessness-with-idols (Gen 38:24, Num 14:33, 2Kgs 9:22, Hos 1:2, 2:2,4, 4:12, 5:4, Eze 23:11,29, Nah 3:4).

Nominal-form of zanah (play-harlot, H2181) for abstract-idolatry-metaphor distinguished from zenunim (harlotries-plural, H2183) and taznut (harlotry-general, H8457) by nominal-abstract-aspect (Num 14:33, Jer 3:2,9, 13:27, Eze 23:27, Hos 4:11, 6:10).
Qal: cast off, abandon (mostly God rejects people/person); the hyphenated English marks throwing-away.
Piel; Dan leaps as young lion from Bashan; Deut 33:22.
Object-of-horror among peoples (Deut 28:25 (Ketib); Jer 15:4; 24:9; 29:18; 34:17; 2Chr 29:8; Eze 23:46). Hyphenated to distinguish horror-object-aspect from H8047 shamma 'horror' (state).
Original concordant: Zaavan-son-Ezer-Horite-Seir. Gen-sons-Ezer-Bilhan-Zaavan-Akan and 1Chr-sons-Ezer-Bilhan-Zaavan-Jaakan (Gen 36:27; 1Chr 1:42). Hyphenated.
Small in number or quantity (Job 36:2; Isa 28:10,13; Zech 4:10). Hyphenated to distinguish little-few-aspect from H4592 me'at 'few' and H6996 qaton 'small'.
Aramaic for little-horn coming-up among-ten; Dan 7:8.
From √zʿm (utter-with-indignation); verbally condemn/curse (Num 23:7-8 Balaam), divine indignation (Ps 7:12, Mal 1:4); concordantly 'denounce' distinguishes from arar (H779 curse).
Cloudy-vexed appearance show or rage (Gen 40:6; 1Kgs 20:43; 21:4; Dan 1:10; 2Chr 26:19). Hyphenated to distinguish stormy-vexed-aspect from H639 af 'anger'; family with H2197 za'af.
Violent-surging displeasure of king or God (2Chr 16:10; 28:9; Prov 19:12; Isa 30:30; Jonah 1:15; Mic 7:9). Hyphenated to distinguish stormy-displeasure-aspect from H2750 chori 'wrath'.
Qal: loudly call for help or in pain; distinguished from qara (call) and shaaq; concordantly 'cry-out'.
Aramaic Peal; king-cries-loud at den; Dan 6:20.
From √zaaq (cry-out); loud anguish-call for help; the hyphenated English marks distress.
Proper noun, northern border-place; Num 34:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ziphron.
Pitch-and-bitumen-at-Moses-basket and judgment-burning (Ex 2:3; Isa 34:9 twice). Hyphenated to distinguish pitch-asphalt-tar-aspect from H2564 chemar 'asphalt-bitumen' (already assigned).
Adjective/verb: come of age; noun zaqen 'elder' as office-bearer; concordantly 'old'.
Root zqn (be-old, H2204); zaqan = beard (H2206). Substantively zaqen = old-of-beard = elder/aged. 'Old' as quality; elders in context.
Face-hair as sign of adulthood; concordantly 'beard'.
Bodily state of being-old (not the old man); Jacob; Gen 48:10.
Child-born-at-grey-age (Gen 21:2,7; 37:3; 44:20). Hyphenated to distinguish old-age-offspring-aspect from H2207 zoqen 'high-age' and H2209 ziqnah 'aged-years'.
State of being-very-aged (Gen 24:36; 48:10; 1Kgs 11:4; 15:23; Ps 71:9,18; Prov 23:22; Isa 46:4). Hyphenated to distinguish age-state from H7872 seyvah 'grey-old-age' (physical-grey-hair).

The raising of the bowed - Psalm 145:14 (the LORD upholds all that fall, and raises up all those that be bowed down) and Psalm 146:8 (the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD raises them that are bowed down).
Metal or wine sift to purity (1Chr 28:18; 29:4; Job 28:1; 36:27; Ps 12:7; Isa 25:6; Mal 3:3). Hyphenated to distinguish filter-purification-action from H1305 barar 'purify'.

Decorative relief-rim in gold around sacred-furniture (Ex 25:11,24-25 ark-and-table 'gold-ornamental-rim around', 30:3-4 incense-altar, 37:2,11-12,26-27 building-execution); only 10x exclusively in tabernacle.
Pual; mountain-streams shrivel in summer; Job 6:17.
Proper noun ('born-in-Babel'); leader of first return; concordantly transliterated.
Aramaic parallel to Hebrew Zerubbabel; Ezra 5:2; concordantly transliterated.
Border-river between Moab and Edom (Num 21:12; Deut 2:13 twice, 14). English convention: Zered. 'Willow-flowing'.
Qal: scatter, disperse (winnow grain, scatter peoples); concordantly 'winnow'.
Unique lexeme. Upper-arm, also figuratively 'strength'. 'Arm' covers anatomical and metonymic.
Lev-as-of-water-sprinkled-falls-on-seed-unclean and Isa-as-garden-the-sowing-causes-to-spring (Lev 11:37; Isa 61:11). Hyphenated to distinguish sown-vegetable-seed-crop-aspect from H2233 zera.
Qal: shining come up (sun, light, leprosy); concordantly 'rise'.
Proper noun ('rising'); twin-son of Judah, also Edomite/Cushite; concordantly transliterated.
Gentilic-name of Judah's descendants (Num 26:13,20; Josh 7:17; 1Chr 27:11,13). English convention: Zerahite.
Priest-ancestor and Levitical family-head (1Chr 5:32; 6:36; Ezra 7:4; 8:4). English convention: Zerahiah. 'YHWH-has-risen'.
The sweeping-away by torrential-rain - Psalm 77:18 (the clouds poured out water) and Psalm 90:5 (You carry them away as with a flood).

Violent-short-storm-shower distinguished from H1653 geshem (downpour-long-duration) by short-violent-aspect (Job 24:8 poor-homeless 'from-storm-of-mountains they-are-drenched, and-without-shelter they-embrace-rock').
Seminal discharge or flood - in Ezekiel 23:20 (whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses) and Ezekiel 23:20-repetition; from H2229 zaram (stream, pour out).
Qal: scatter seed (literally and metaphorically); concordantly 'sow'.
Root zr' (sow, H2232). 'Seed' covers plant-seed and human descent; 'descendants' breaks concordance with plant-seed.
Aramaic seed-descendants (Dan 2:43 mingle-themselves-with-seed-of-men); cognate Hebrew H2233 zera.
First-sense zeroa; ten-day-test of sown-vegetable-eat; Dan 1:12.
Second-sense zeron; pulse-vegetable instead of king's-food; Dan 1:16.
Qal: pour out blood or water with swing, scatter over altar; concordantly 'sprinkle'.
Poel; Shunammite child sneezed seven times for resurrection; 2Kgs 4:35.
Haman's wife and counsellor in downfall (Esth 5:10,14; 6:13 twice). English convention: Zeresh. 'Gold-glitter'.
Hand-breadth-measure between thumb and little-finger spread (Ex 28:16; 39:9; 1Sam 17:4; Isa 40:12; Eze 43:13). Hyphenated to preserve spread-handspan-aspect.
Post-exilic-family-ancestor and covenant-sealer (Ezra 2:8; 8:5; 10:27; Neh 7:13; 10:14). English convention: Zattu. 'Glitter-olive'.
Proper noun, sixth eunuch attendant of Ahasuerus; Esth 1:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zethar.
Hapax Job 31:33 in-bosom-sin-hide; possibly variant H2436 cheq.
Niphal/Hithpael: hide oneself for danger or shame; concordantly 'hide-oneself'.
Fearful-shelter in mountains or caves (Josh 2:16; 1Sam 19:2; 2Sam 18:3; 2Kgs 6:29). Hyphenated to distinguish hide-shelter-aspect from H5641 sathar 'hide' and H2244 chava 'hide-oneself'.
Aramaic for no-harm-done against king; Dan 6:22.
Bruise-stripe without open bleeding (Gen 4:23; Ex 21:25; Ps 38:6; Prov 20:30; Isa 1:6; 53:5). Hyphenated to distinguish bruised-subdermal from H6482 petsa 'open-wound' (bleeding).
Fruits or grain with stick beat-loose (Deut 24:20; Judg 6:11; Ruth 2:17; Isa 27:12). Hyphenated to distinguish stick-beat-thresh-aspect from H1758 dush 'thresh'.
Head of a priestly-family whose descent could not be proved and who were therefore excluded from the priesthood - Ezra 2:61, Nehemiah 7:63.
Qal: hold in pledge (cloak, upper millstone), regulated in Ex 22; the hyphenated English distinguishes from chaval II 'damage', III 'have birth-pangs'.

Second homonym distinguished from chaval-I (take-pledge) and chaval-III (birth-pang); Qal/Piel: pernicious-act/bring-to-ruin (Neh 1:7 'we have heavily-corrupted-against-you', Job 17:1 spirit-undone, Eccl 5:6, Isa 13:5, 32:7, 54:16, Mic 2:10).

Ex-not-take-pledge-millstone and Deut-not-take-pledge-widow's-garment and Amos-clothes-pledged-by-every-altar (Ex 22:25; Deut 24:6,17; Amos 2:8). Hyphenated to distinguish take-pledge-aspect from chaval-I.
Aramaic-verb for destroying or causing harm (Ezra 6:12; Dan 2:44; 4:20; 6:23,27; 7:14). Hyphenated to mark Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H2254a chaval-I.
Twisted rope; metaphorically also measuring-line/inheritance; distinguished from chevel II (pangs) and chevel III (region); concordantly 'cord'.
By-measuring-line-allotted ground-portion (Deut 32:9; Josh 17:5,14; 19:9; Ps 16:6; 78:55; 105:11; Mic 2:5). Hyphenated; distinguishes allotted-portion from homonym H2256a chevel-I 'cord'.
Aramaic Pael; Dan 6:23 'no harm was found upon him'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix per principle, distinguished from H2255 chaval-Aram 'corrupt'.
Item taken in security; Eze 18:7,12,16; 33:15. Hyphenated to mark security-object distinct from H2258b chavolah 'borrowed-pledge'.
Sub-sense of chavol; the act-of-pledging or thing-borrowed (Eze 18:7,12,16). Hyphenated to mark loan-aspect.
Qal-participle of chaval (rope-handler); Jonah 1:6 'master-of-the-rope', Eze 27:8,27-29. Hyphenated to mark rope-handling-mariner.
Prov 23:34 'top of mast'; rope-mast complex. Hyphenated to mark ship's-pole-with-rigging aspect.
Bulb-flower of plain (Song 2:1; Isa 35:1). Hyphenated to mark bulb-flower-of-plain; KJV 'rose' is botanically incorrect — Hebrew names a crocus or narcissus, not the modern rose (a Latin loan).
Ancestor of Rechabites (Jer 35:3). English convention: Habazziniah.
Qal/Pi: hold-close-in-arms (Gen 29:13; 33:4; 48:10; Eze 3:5; 2Kgs 4:16; Ecc 3:5; 4:5; Job 24:8; Prov 4:8; 5:20; Lam 4:5).
Prov 6:10; 24:33 'a-little-folding-of-the-hands-to-sleep'. Hyphenated to mark idle-clasp distinct from H2263 chavaq embrace-action.
Prophet whose name is intensive of chavaq (embracer); Hab 1:1; 3:1. English convention: Habakkuk.
Qal/Pi/Pu/Hith: be-allied, joined-together, ally-oneself (Gen 14:3; Ex 26:6; 28:7; 39:4; 2Chr 20:35,36,37; Eze 1:9,11; Hos 4:17; Ps 94:20; Dan 11:6,23). Standard concordant 'join'.
Magical-binding-formula (Deut 18:11; Isa 47:9,12; Ps 58:6). Hyphenated to mark binding-spell-aspect; from chavar 'join/bind' in incantation-sense.
Multiple persons including Asherite (Gen 46:17), Kenite husband of Jael (Judg 4:11,17,21; 5:24), Judahite (1Chr 4:18), Benjamites (1Chr 8:17,22). English convention: Heber.
Aramaic-noun for fellow/colleague (Dan 2:13,17,18). Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix; cognate of Heb H2270 chaver.
Allied-fellow (Judg 20:11; Ps 45:8; 119:63; Prov 28:24; Ecc 4:10; Song 1:7; 8:13; Isa 1:23; 44:11; Eze 37:16,19). Standard concordant 'companion'.
Job 41:6 'partners-divide-him'. Hyphenated to mark trading-association distinct from H2270 chaver companion.
Jer 13:23 'can-Cushite-change-skin or-leopard-his-spots'. Hyphenated reduplicated stem expresses pattern-of-marks.
Aramaic feminine of chaver; Dan 7:20 'his-fellow-horns'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Job 34:8 'company-with-workers-of-iniquity'. Hyphenated to mark associative-band distinct from H2270 chaver individual.
Levite descendant of Kohath (Ex 6:18; Num 3:19,27; 26:58; 1Chr 6:2,18; 15:9; 23:12,19). Hyphenated to distinguish Levitical-person from H2275a place-name.
Gentilic of Hebron-II (Num 3:27; 26:58; 1Chr 26:23,30,31). English convention: Hebronite.
Gentilic of Heber the Asherite (Num 26:45). English convention: Heberite.
Tabernacle-curtain coupling-piece (Ex 26:4,10; 36:11,17). Hyphenated to mark joined-pair-section distinct from H2279 chovereth.
Tabernacle/ephod-coupling fastener (Ex 26:4,10; 28:27; 39:20). Hyphenated to mark fastening-clasp distinct from H2278 chaveret curtain-section.
Qal/Pi/Pu: bind on (saddle Gen 22:3; turban Ex 29:9; Lev 8:13), wound-bind (Isa 1:6; 30:26; 61:1; Eze 30:21; Ps 147:3; Job 5:18). Hyphenated to mark binding-action across saddle/cloth/wound objects.
Pan-baked priestly-bread (1Chr 9:31). Hyphenated to mark griddle-cake form distinct from H2471 challah ring-cake.

Pilgrim-festival (Ex 10:9; 12:14; 13:6; 23:14-18; 32:5; 34:18,22,25; Lev 23:6,34,39,41; Num 28:17; 29:12; Deut 16:10,13-16; Judg 21:19; Ezr 3:4; Neh 8:14,18; Ps 81:4; Hos 2:13; 9:5; Amos 5:21; 8:10; Nah 1:15; Zech 14:16-19). Hyphenated to mark cultic-celebration distinct from H4150 mo'ed appointed-time.
Edible-locust species (Lev 11:22; Num 13:33; Ecc 12:5; Isa 40:22; 2Chr 7:13). Hyphenated; distinguished from H697 arbeh swarm-locust and H1462 gob locust-multitude.
Nethinim ancestor (Neh 7:48). English convention: Hagabah. Sub-sense paired with H2286b.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:45) variant spelling. English convention: Hagabah. Sub-sense paired with H2286a.

Qal: celebrate pilgrim-feast, dance-in-procession (Ex 5:1; 12:14; 23:14; Lev 23:39,41; Num 29:12; Deut 16:15; 1Sam 30:16; Ps 42:5; 107:27; Nah 1:15; Zech 14:16,18,19). Hyphenated to mark cultic-celebration distinct from H8055 samach rejoice.
Hide-place in cliffs (Song 2:14; Jer 49:16; Obad 1:3). Hyphenated to mark crevice-shelter distinct from H4869 misgav stronghold.
Loins-girded for travel/battle (Ex 12:11; 1Sam 17:39; Eze 23:15). Hyphenated to mark belt-fastened-state distinct from H2290a chagor noun.
Warrior's-sash (1Sam 18:4; 2Sam 18:11; 1Kgs 2:5; 2Kgs 3:21). Hyphenated; distinguished from H2290b chagorah female-belt.
Worn around hips/loins (Gen 3:7 fig-leaf-aprons; 2Sam 18:11; 1Kgs 2:5; Isa 3:24; Prov 31:24). Hyphenated to mark hip-cloth distinct from H2290a chagor warrior-belt.
Son of Gad (Gen 46:16; Num 26:15). English convention: Haggi. 'Festal'.
Post-exilic prophet (Hag 1:1,3,12,13; 2:1,10,13,14,20; Ezr 5:1; 6:14). English convention: Haggai. 'Festive-one'.
Levitical-temple-divisional reference paired with Iddo. Hyphenated to mark Levitical-divisional aspect distinct from H2292a prophet.
Mother of Adonijah (2Sam 3:4; 1Kgs 1:5,11; 2:13; 1Chr 3:2). English convention: Haggith. 'Festal'.
Daughter of Zelophehad (Num 26:33; 27:1; 36:11; Josh 17:3). English convention: Hoglah. 'Partridge'.
Eze 33:30 'one-with-other'; rare contracted form cognate with Aramaic chad. Hyphenated to mark joint-singular.
Aramaic numeral-one (Dan 2:9,31,35; 3:19; 6:2; 7:5,16; Ezr 4:8; 5:13; 6:2). Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Sharp-edged (Ps 57:4; Prov 5:4; Isa 49:2; Eze 5:1). Standard concordant 'sharp'.
Qal/Hi: of edge or pursuit (Hab 1:8 sharper-than-evening-wolves; Prov 27:17 iron-sharpens-iron; Eze 21:14,15,16). Hyphenated; family with H2299.
Hithpael; Gen 49:6 'with-their-assembly let-not my-honor be-united'. Hyphenated to mark reflexive-joining distinct from H3161 yachad join.
Son of Ishmael (Gen 25:15; 1Chr 1:30). Hyphenated to distinguish from Edomite Hadad-kings (H1908). English convention: Hadad.
Qal/Pi: be-glad (Ex 18:9 Jethro; Job 3:6; Ps 21:6). Standard concordant 'rejoice'.
Job 41:30 'sharp-potsherds-under-Leviathan'. Hyphenated to mark intensive-form of H2299 chad.
Festal-cult-joy (1Chr 16:27; Neh 8:10 'joy-of-YHWH-is-your-strength'). Hyphenated; distinguished from H8057 simchah broader-joy.
Aramaic; Ezr 6:16 dedication-joy. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Aramaic; Dan 2:32 chest-of-silver in image-statue. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Benjamite town (Ezr 2:33; Neh 7:37; 11:34). English convention: Hadid. 'Sharp'.
Isa 38:11 'land-of-the-living'; rendering follows root chadal cease — i.e. 'world-where-things-cease'. Hyphenated to mark cease-state.
Adjective from chadal (Ps 39:5 transient; Isa 53:3 forsaken-of-men; Eze 3:27). Hyphenated to mark dual ceasing/abandoned aspect.
Ephraimite chief's father (2Chr 28:12). English convention: Hadlai.
Prickly hedge-plant (Prov 15:19; Mic 7:4). Hyphenated to mark stinging-bramble distinct from H6975 qotz thorn.
Eden-river and Daniel's-vision-river (Gen 2:14; Dan 10:4). Hyphenated to mark Hebrew-name-and-classical-equivalent; English convention KJV Hiddekel, modern Tigris.
Eze 21:14 sword 'enters-into-secret-chamber'. Hyphenated to mark penetrating-into-room aspect; family with H2315 cheder chamber.

Bedchamber, storeroom, innermost-room (Gen 43:30; Ex 7:28; Deut 32:25; Judg 3:24; 15:1; 16:9,12; 2Sam 4:7; 13:10; 1Kgs 1:15; 20:30; 22:25; 2Kgs 6:12; 9:2; 11:2; 2Chr 18:24; 22:11; Ps 105:30; Prov 7:27; 18:8; 20:27,30; 24:4; 26:22; Song 1:4; 3:4; Isa 26:20; Joel 2:16). Hyphenated to mark interior-private-room distinct from H1004 bayit house.
Pi: make-new, renew (1Sam 11:14; 2Chr 15:8; 24:4,12; Job 10:17; Ps 51:12; 103:5; 104:30; Isa 61:4; Lam 5:21). Standard concordant 'renew'.
Wife of Shaharaim (1Chr 8:9). Hyphenated. English convention: Hodesh.
Aramaic; Ezr 6:4 'new-house'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix; cognate Heb H2319.

Northern boundary-mountain (Deut 3:8,9; 4:48; Josh 11:3,17; 12:1,5; 13:5,11; 1Chr 5:23; Ps 42:6; 89:12; 133:3; Song 4:8). English convention: Hermon.
Ps 42:6 'from-the-Hermons' — plural-form for the mountain-range. Standard concordant.
Mesopotamian city of Abram's stay (Gen 11:31,32; 12:4,5; 27:43; 28:10; 29:4; 2Kgs 19:12; Isa 37:12; Eze 27:23; Acts 7:2,4). English convention: Haran.
Son of Caleb by Ephah (1Chr 2:46). Hyphenated.
Sanballat the Horonite (Neh 2:10,19; 13:28). English convention: Horonite.
Moabite town (Isa 15:5; Jer 48:3,5,34). English convention: Horonaim.
Poetic sun (Judg 8:13; 14:18; Job 9:7). Standard concordant 'sun'; distinct from H8121 shemesh by poetic register.
Amorite-held mountain (Judg 1:35). Hyphenated. English convention: Mount Heres.
Cool-rainy season (Gen 8:22; Job 29:4; Ps 74:17; Prov 20:4; Jer 36:22; Amos 3:15; Zech 14:8). Hyphenated.
Qal/Ni: cut, decree-decisively (Ex 11:7; Lev 22:22; Josh 10:21; 2Sam 5:24; 1Kgs 20:40; Job 14:5; Isa 10:23; 28:22; Dan 9:26,27; 11:36). Hyphenated to mark cutting-into-decision.
Ps 73:4; Isa 58:6. Hyphenated to mark binding-cords-of-injustice.
Qal/Ni/Pilpel: be-scorched (Job 30:30; Ps 69:3; 102:3; Prov 6:28; Isa 24:6; Jer 6:29; 17:6; Eze 15:4,5; 24:11). Hyphenated.
Pottery-fragment (Lev 6:21; 11:33; 14:5,50; 15:12; Num 5:17; Ps 22:15; Prov 26:23; Isa 30:14; 45:9; Jer 19:1; 32:14; Lam 4:2; Eze 23:34). Standard concordant 'potsherd'.

Qal: plow-fields, also engrave (Deut 22:10; Judg 14:18; 1Sam 8:12; 14:14; 1Kgs 19:19; Job 1:14; 4:8; Ps 129:3; Prov 3:29; 6:14,18; 12:20; 14:22; 20:4; 21:4; Isa 28:24; 45:9; Jer 17:1; 26:18; Hos 10:11,13; Amos 6:12; 9:13; Mic 3:12). Hyphenated to mark dual sense of agricultural-and-craft-cutting.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:52; Neh 7:54). English convention: Harsha.
Forest where David hid (1Sam 22:5). English convention: Hereth.
Ephod's-belt of skilful-work (Ex 28:8,27,28; 29:5; 39:5,20,21; Lev 8:7). Hyphenated to mark crafted-girdle.
Stood with Ezra at law-reading (Neh 8:4). English convention: Hashbaddanah.
Son of Zerubbabel (1Chr 3:20). English convention: Hashubah.

Amorite capital, then Reubenite-Gadite-Levitical city (Num 21:25-34; 32:3,37; Deut 1:4; 2:24,26,30; 3:2,6; 4:46; 29:7; Josh 9:10; 12:2,5; 13:10,17,21,26,27; 21:39; Judg 11:19,26; 1Chr 6:81; Neh 9:22; Song 7:4; Isa 15:4; 16:8,9; Jer 48:2,34,45; 49:3). English convention: Heshbon.
Multiple Levites and post-exilic figures (1Chr 6:45; 9:14; 25:3,19; 26:30; 27:17; 2Chr 35:9; Ezr 8:19,24; Neh 3:17; 10:11; 11:15,22; 12:21,24). English convention: Hashabiah. 'YHWH-has-reckoned'.
Wall-builder and Levite (Neh 3:10; 9:5). English convention: Hashabneiah.
Multiple persons including wall-builder (1Chr 9:14; Neh 3:11,23; 10:24; 11:15). English convention: Hasshub.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:43; Neh 7:46). English convention: Hasupha.

Qal/Hi/Hophal: be-dark, become-darkened (Ex 10:15; 1Kgs 18:45; Job 3:9; 18:6; Ps 69:23; 105:28; Ecc 12:2,3; Isa 5:30; 13:10; Eze 30:18; 32:7,8; Mic 3:6; Lam 4:8; 5:17). Hyphenated to mark darkness-falling.
Gen 15:12; Isa 8:22; 50:10; Mic 3:6; Ps 82:5; 139:12. Hyphenated to mark dense-dark distinct from H2822 general darkness.
Post-exilic family-head (Ezr 2:19; 10:33; Neh 7:22; 8:4; 10:18). English convention: Hashum.
Negev town of Judah (Josh 15:27). English convention: Heshmon.
Eze 1:4,27; 8:2 — radiance of throne-vision. Hyphenated to preserve all candidate-glosses (electrum, glow-bronze, amber).
High-priest's pectoral with twelve stones and Urim-Thummim (Ex 25:7; 28:4,15-30; 29:5; 35:9,27; 39:8-21; Lev 8:8). Hyphenated to mark cultic-judgment-pouch.
Qal: lay-bare, uncover (Ps 29:9; Isa 20:4; 30:14; 47:2; 52:10; Jer 13:26; 49:10; Eze 4:7; Joel 1:7; Hag 2:16). Hyphenated.
Qal/Pi: be-attached-in-affection (Gen 34:8; Deut 7:7; 10:15; 21:11; 1Kgs 9:19; 2Chr 8:6; Ps 91:14; Isa 38:17). Hyphenated to mark covenant-affection distinct from H157 ahav love.
Pi/Pu: girt with silver fillets (Ex 27:17; 38:17,28). Hyphenated.
Gentilic of Hushah (2Sam 21:18; 23:27; 1Chr 11:29; 20:4; 27:11). English convention: Hushathite.
Son of Canaan, ancestor of Hittites (Gen 10:15; 23:3,5,7,10,16,18,20; 25:10; 27:46; 49:32; 1Chr 1:13). English convention: Heth.
Northern boundary site (Eze 47:15; 48:1). English convention: Hethlon.

Qal/Ni/Pi/Hi: seal, close-up (Lev 15:3; Deut 32:34; 1Kgs 21:8; Esth 3:12; 8:8,10; Job 9:7; 14:17; 24:16; 33:16; 37:7; Song 4:12; Isa 8:16; 29:11; Jer 32:10,11,14,44; Eze 28:12; Dan 6:17; 8:26; 9:24; 12:4,9; Neh 9:38; 10:1). Hyphenated to mark sealing-action distinct from H5640 satam shut.
Hithp: form-marriage-alliance (Gen 34:9; Deut 7:3; Josh 23:12; 1Sam 18:21-27; 1Kgs 3:1; 2Chr 18:1; Ezr 9:14). Hyphenated.
Hithp variant: become-related-by-marriage (1Sam 18:22,23,26,27). Hyphenated to distinguish from H2859a alliance-action.
Qal: break-through wall (Job 24:16; Eze 8:8; 12:5,7,12; Jonah 1:13; Amos 9:2). Hyphenated.

Qal: butcher-animal-or-people (Gen 43:16; Ex 21:37; 22:1; Deut 28:31; 1Sam 25:11; Ps 37:14; Prov 9:2; Isa 14:21; 22:13; 53:7; Jer 11:19; 12:3; 25:34; 51:40; Lam 2:21; Eze 21:10,15,28). Standard concordant 'slaughter'.
Aramean son of Nahor (Gen 22:24). English convention: Tebah.
Royal-executioner-and-cook (Gen 37:36; 39:1; 40:3,4; 41:10,12; 1Sam 9:23,24; 2Kgs 25:8-20; Jer 39:9-13; 40:1-5; 41:10; 43:6; 52:12-30; Lam 2:20). Hyphenated to preserve dual function.

Qal/Ni: immerse, dip (Gen 37:31; Ex 12:22; Lev 4:6,17; 9:9; 14:6,16,51; Num 19:18; Deut 33:24; Josh 3:15; Ruth 2:14; 1Sam 14:27; 2Kgs 5:14; 8:15; Job 9:31; Eze 23:15). Hyphenated to mark immersion-action.
Qal/Pu/Hophal: be-sunk-or-fixed (Ex 15:4; 1Sam 17:49; Job 38:6; Ps 9:15; 69:2,14; Prov 8:25; Jer 38:6,22; Lam 2:9). Hyphenated to mark sinking-or-fixing-into.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:43; Neh 7:46). English convention: Tabbaoth.
Tenth month of Hebrew calendar (Esth 2:16). Hyphenated. English convention: Tebeth.
Place to which Midianites fled (Judg 7:22). English convention: Tabbath.
Variant; clean, of glass-pavement of YHWH (Ex 24:10). Hyphenated.

Qal: be-pleasant, well, fitting (Num 24:1; Judg 11:25; 1Sam 16:23; 2Sam 3:36; 1Kgs 12:7; 2Chr 10:7; Esth 1:21; 2:4,9; Ps 13:6; 49:18; 119:68; Prov 3:30; 30:29; Ecc 7:3,10; Jer 18:4). Standard concordant.
Region east of Jordan (Judg 11:3,5; 2Sam 10:6,8). Hyphenated. English convention: Tob.
Levite teacher (2Chr 17:8). Hyphenated. English convention: Tob-adonijah.

Levite teacher and Ammonite-opponent of Nehemiah, post-exilic returnee (2Chr 17:8; Ezr 2:60; Neh 2:10,19; 4:3,7; 6:1,12,14,17,19; 7:62; 13:4,7,8; Zech 6:10,14). English convention: Tobiah. 'YHWH-is-good'.
Hi/Hophal/Pilpel: cast-out, hurl (1Sam 18:11; 20:33; Jer 16:13; 22:26,28; Jonah 1:4,5,12,15; Job 41:9 (Heb 41:1); Isa 22:17; Eze 32:4; Ps 37:24). Hyphenated.
Job 38:36; Ps 51:6. Hyphenated to mark inner-organs/inner-being.
Qal: grind grain or mill (Num 11:8; Deut 9:21; Judg 16:21; Job 31:10; Isa 3:15; 47:2; Lam 5:13; Ecc 12:3,4). Standard concordant 'grind'.
Wet-clay, miry-bog (2Sam 22:43; Ps 18:42; 40:2; 69:14; Isa 41:25; 57:20; Jer 38:6; Mic 7:10; Nah 3:14; Zech 9:3; 10:5). Hyphenated.
Fortified-encampment, dovecot (Gen 25:16; Num 31:10; 1Chr 6:54; Ps 69:25; Song 8:9; Eze 25:4). Hyphenated.
Place where Saul mustered (1Sam 15:4). English convention: Telaim. 'Lambs'.
1Sam 7:9; Isa 40:11; 65:25. Hyphenated to mark suckling-lamb distinct from H3532 keves yearling-lamb.
Negev town and gatekeeper-ancestor (Josh 15:24; Ezr 10:24). English convention: Telem.
Levitical gatekeeper-family-head (1Chr 9:17; Ezr 2:42; Neh 7:45; 11:19; 12:25). English convention: Talmon.
Qal: perceive-by-tongue, also discern (1Sam 14:24,29,43; 2Sam 3:35; 19:35; Job 12:11; 34:3; Ps 34:8; Prov 31:18; Jonah 3:7). Hyphenated to mark dual physical-and-mental aspect.

Physical-flavor and mental-discernment (Ex 16:31; Num 11:8; 1Sam 21:13; 25:33; Job 6:6,30; 12:20; Ps 34:1 (title); 119:66; Prov 11:22; 26:16; Jonah 3:7). Hyphenated to preserve dual aspect of physical-flavor and discernment-judgment.
Qal/Pi: outspread, raise-up-children (Lam 2:22; Isa 48:13). Hyphenated to mark dual aspect.
Measure of palm-width (Ex 25:25; 37:12; 1Kgs 7:26; 2Chr 4:5; Eze 40:5,43; 43:13). Standard concordant.
Qal: plaster-with-falsehood (Job 13:4; 14:17; Ps 119:69). Hyphenated to mark slanderous-coating.
Daughter of Solomon (1Kgs 4:11). English convention: Taphath.
Animal carcass torn by beasts (Gen 31:39; Ex 22:13,31; Lev 7:24; 17:15; 22:8; Eze 4:14; 44:31; Nah 2:12). Hyphenated to mark prohibited-by-tearing distinct from H2964 teref captured-prey.
Multiple persons (2Kgs 25:23; Jer 35:3; 40:8; Eze 8:11; 11:1). English convention: Jaazaniah. 'YHWH-hears'.
Multiple persons including the judge (Num 32:41; Deut 3:14; Josh 13:30; Judg 10:3,5; 1Kgs 4:13; 1Chr 2:22,23; 20:5; Esth 2:5). English convention: Jair.
Gentilic of Jair (2Sam 20:26). English convention: Jairite.
Hi: take-it-upon-oneself, deign (Gen 18:27,31; Deut 1:5; Josh 7:7; 17:12; Judg 1:27,35; 17:11; 19:6; 1Sam 12:22; 17:39; 2Sam 7:29; 2Kgs 5:23; 6:3; 1Chr 17:27; Job 6:9,28; Hos 5:11). Hyphenated.
Ni/Pi: despair (1Sam 27:1; Job 6:26; Ecc 2:20; Isa 57:10; Jer 2:25; 18:12). Hyphenated.
Pre-Davidic name of Jerusalem (Josh 18:28; Judg 19:10,11; 1Chr 11:4,5). English convention: Jebus.
Two Canaanite kings of Hazor (Josh 11:1; Judg 4:2,7,17,23,24; Ps 83:9). English convention: Jabin.
Cain's descendant, father of tent-dwelling cattle-keepers (Gen 4:20). English convention: Jabal.
Manassite border-town (Josh 17:11; Judg 1:27; 2Kgs 9:27). English convention: Ibleam.
Border-town of Judah and Naphtali (Josh 15:11; 19:33). English convention: Jabneel. 'Mighty-One-causes-to-build'.
Tributary of Jordan (Gen 32:22; Num 21:24; Deut 2:37; 3:16; Josh 12:2; Judg 11:13,22). English convention: Jabbok.
Father of Zechariah (Isa 8:2). English convention: Jeberechiah. 'YHWH-blesses'.
Num 6:3; Job 13:25; Isa 56:3; Eze 17:24; 21:3; 37:2,4; Nah 1:10. Standard concordant.
Jabesh-Gilead and father of Shallum (Judg 21:8-14; 1Sam 11:1-10; 31:11-13; 2Sam 2:4-5; 21:12; 1Chr 10:11,12; 2Kgs 15:10,13,14). English convention: Jabesh.
Spy from Issachar, also David's mighty man (Num 13:7; 2Sam 23:36; 1Chr 3:22). English convention: Igal.
Gadite city (Num 32:35; Judg 8:11). English convention: Jogbehah.
Father of Hanan (Jer 35:4). English convention: Igdaliah. 'YHWH-makes-great'.
Negev town of Judah (Josh 15:21). English convention: Jagur.
Toil and its earned-product (Gen 31:42; Deut 28:33; Job 10:3; 39:11,16; Ps 78:46; 109:11; 128:2; Prov 5:10; Isa 45:14; 55:2; Jer 3:24; 20:5; Eze 23:29; Hos 12:8; Hag 1:11). Hyphenated.
Father of Bukki (Num 34:22). English convention: Jogli.
Qal: dread (Deut 9:19; 28:60; Job 3:25; 9:28; Ps 119:39; Hos 10:5). Hyphenated.
Aramaic name Laban gave the heap (Gen 31:47). Hyphenated. 'Heap-of-witness'.

Hand, also figuratively for power, control, side, monument, axle (one of the most frequent nouns in Hebrew, ~1,617 occurrences across all OT books — particularly central to covenant 'mighty-hand-and-outstretched-arm' formula in Ex/Deut, prophetic 'hand of YHWH', wisdom 'hand of the diligent' in Prov, etc). Standard concordant 'hand'.
Pi: cast lots (Joel 3:3; Obad 1:11; Nah 3:10). Hyphenated.
Covenant-signer and high-priest (Neh 10:21; 12:11,22). English convention: Jaddua.
Levitical chief musician (1Chr 9:16; 16:38,41,42; 25:1,3,6; 2Chr 5:12; 29:14; 35:15; Neh 11:17; Ps 39 title; 62 title; 77 title). English convention: Jeduthun.
Deut 33:12; Ps 45:1; 60:5; 84:1; 108:6; 127:2; Isa 5:1; Jer 11:15. Standard concordant.
Mother of Josiah (2Kgs 22:1). English convention: Jedidah. 'Beloved'.
YHWH's name for Solomon (2Sam 12:25). English convention: Jedidiah. 'Beloved-of-YHWH'.
Son of Nahor (Gen 22:22). English convention: Jidlaph.

Qal/Ni/Pi/Pu/Hi/Hithp: know-experientially, perceive, recognize, also euphemism for sexual-knowing (Gen 2:9,17; 3:5,7,22; 4:1,17,25; 8:11; 9:24; 12:11; 15:8,13; 18:19,21; 19:5,8,33,35; 20:6,7; 21:26; 22:12; 24:14,16,21; 25:27; 27:2; 28:16; 29:5; 30:26,29; 31:6,32; 33:13; 38:9,16,26; 39:6,8; 41:21,31,39; 42:23,33,34; 43:7,22; 44:15,27; 45:1; 47:6; 48:19; 50:20+ extensive across all OT). 'Know' is the standard concordant rendering covering experiential, intellectual, sexual, and covenantal knowing. Standard concordant.
Multiple priests and post-exilic returnees (1Chr 9:10; 24:7; Ezr 2:36; Neh 3:10; 7:39; 11:10; 12:6,7,19,21; Zech 6:10,14). English convention: Jedaiah. 'YHWH-knows'.

Spiritist, consulter-of-knowledge (Lev 19:31; 20:6,27; Deut 18:11; 1Sam 28:3,9; 2Kgs 21:6; 23:24; 2Chr 33:6; Isa 8:19; 19:3). Hyphenated to mark forbidden-knowing-spirit distinct from H178 ov necromancer.
Aramaic; extensive use in Ezra-Daniel. Hyphenated.
Wife in Judah's genealogy (1Chr 4:18). English convention: Jehudijah. 'The-Jewess'.
Multiple kings of Israel and Judah (2Kgs 10:35; 13:1,4,7,8,9,10,22,25; 14:1,8,17; 23:30,31,34; 1Chr 3:15; 2Chr 21:17; 25:17,23,25; 36:1,2,4). English convention: Jehoahaz. 'YHWH-has-grasped'.
Long-form of Joash, kings of Israel and Judah (2Kgs 11:21; 12:1-21; 13:10,25; 14:8,9,11,13,15,16,17,23). English convention: Jehoash. 'YHWH-has-given'.

Patriarch and his tribe and the southern kingdom (Gen 29:35; 35:23; 37:26; 38:1-26; 43:3-44:34; 46:12,28; 49:8-10; Ex 1:2; 31:2; 35:30; 38:22; Num 1:7,26,27; 2:3,9; 7:12,17; 10:14; 13:6; 26:19-22; 34:19+ extensive — entire books of Kings, Chronicles, much of Prophets and Psalms). English convention: Judah. 'Praise'.

Member of tribe-or-kingdom of Judah, later 'Jew' (2Kgs 16:6; 18:26,28; 25:25; 1Chr 4:18; Neh 1:2; 2:16; 3:33,34; 4:1,6; 5:1,8,17; 6:6; 13:23; Esth 2:5; 3:4-13; 4:3,7,13,14,16,17; 5:13; 6:10,13; 8:1,3,5,7,8,9,11,13,16,17; 9:1-31; 10:3; Jer 32:12; 34:9; 38:19; 40:11,12; 41:3; 43:9; 44:1; 52:28,30; Zech 8:23). English convention: Judean (preserves geographic-tribal kernel; 'Jew' is later religious-ethnic specialization).

The Tetragrammaton, the personal name of the Mighty-One revealed at the burning bush (Ex 3:14-15) and central to all OT theology. ~6,828 occurrences across the entire Hebrew Bible. Concordantly transliterated as the four consonants 'YHWH' to preserve the source-text without imposing a reconstructed vocalization (Yahweh/Jehovah are reconstructions; Adonai is reading-tradition). KJV 'LORD' is a translation-by-substitution (avoiding the divine name) and rejected for concordant work; the source has the actual proper-name and the rendering should preserve it.

Same Tetragrammaton, vocalized in the Masoretic text with Elohim-vowels rather than Adonai-vowels because preceded by Adonai (H136) — to avoid 'Adonai-Adonai' read-aloud. Orthographically identical consonants as H3068; the difference is purely Masoretic-pointing for liturgical reading. Concordant rendering: 'YHWH' (same as H3068, since the source-consonants are identical). Used 305 times mostly in 'Adonai YHWH' / 'YHWH-Mighty-One' formulas in Eze.
Multiple persons (2Kgs 25:23; 1Chr 26:3; 2Chr 17:15; 23:1; 28:12; Ezr 10:6,28; Neh 6:18; 12:13,42). English convention: Jehohanan. 'YHWH-has-favored'.
King of Judah (2Kgs 24:6,8,12,15; 25:27; 2Chr 36:8,9; Esth 2:6; Jer 52:31; Eze 1:2). English convention: Jehoiachin. 'YHWH-establishes'.
Priestly division-head (1Chr 9:10; 24:7; Neh 11:10; 12:6,19). English convention: Jehoiarib. 'YHWH-contends'.
Rechabite-founder and David's nephew (2Sam 13:5; 2Kgs 10:15,23; Jer 35:6,8,10,14,16,18,19). English convention: Jehonadab. 'YHWH-impels'.
Long-form of Jonathan (Judg 18:30; 2Sam 21:21; 1Chr 27:25,32; 2Chr 17:8; Ezr 8:6; Neh 12:11,14,18,35; Jer 37:15,20; 38:26; 40:8). English convention: Jehonathan. 'YHWH-has-given'.
Variant of Joseph (Ps 81:5). English convention: Jehoseph.
Mother of Amaziah (2Kgs 14:2; 2Chr 25:1). English convention: Jehoaddan.
Father of Joshua the high priest (1Chr 6:14,15; Hag 1:1,12,14; 2:2,4; Zech 6:11). English convention: Jehozadak. 'YHWH-is-just'.

Two kings of same name in Israel and Judah (1Kgs 22:50; 2Kgs 1:17; 3:1,6; 8:16,21,23,24,25,29; 9:15,17,21,22,23,24; 11:2; 12:18; 1Chr 3:11; 2Chr 17:8; 21:1,3,5,9,16; 22:1,5,6,7,11). English convention: Jehoram. 'YHWH-is-exalted'.
Aunt of Joash who hid him (2Kgs 11:2). English convention: Jehosheba. 'YHWH-is-an-oath'.
Variant of Jehosheba (2Chr 22:11). English convention: Jehoshabeath.

Successor of Moses, also high-priest in Zechariah (Ex 17:9-14; 24:13; 32:17; 33:11; Num 11:28; 13:8,16; 14:6,30,38; 26:65; 27:18,22; 32:12,28; 34:17; Deut 1:38; 3:21,28; 31:3,7,14,23; 34:9; entire book of Joshua + 1Sam 6:14,18; 1Kgs 16:34; 2Kgs 23:8; 1Chr 7:27; Hag 1:1,12,14; 2:2,4; Zech 3:1-9; 6:11). English convention: Joshua. 'YHWH-saves'.

King of Judah and other persons (2Sam 8:16; 20:24; 1Kgs 4:17; 15:24; 22:2-50; 2Kgs 1:17; 3:1-14; 8:16; 9:2,14; 12:18; 1Chr 3:10; 11:43; 15:24; 18:15; 2Chr 17-22; Joel 3:2,12). English convention: Jehoshaphat. 'YHWH-judges'.
Judahite and Levite (1Chr 4:16; 2Chr 29:12). English convention: Jehaleleel. 'Praising-Mighty-One'.
Precious gem on high-priest's breastplate (Ex 28:18; 39:11; Eze 28:13). Hyphenated; KJV 'diamond' is unattested in Iron-Age Levant — concordant 'hard-stone' preserves the root-meaning of the gem.
Moabite town (Num 21:23; Deut 2:32; Josh 13:18; 21:36; Judg 11:20; 1Chr 6:78; Isa 15:4; Jer 48:21,34). English convention: Jahaz.
Multiple Levites and officials (2Kgs 18:18,26,37; 1Chr 6:21; 26:4; 2Chr 29:12; 34:8; Isa 36:3,11,22). English convention: Joah. 'YHWH-is-brother'.
Variant of Jehoahaz (2Chr 21:17; 25:23; 36:2; 36:4). English convention: Joahaz.

Prophet and many others (1Sam 8:2; 1Chr 4:35; 5:4,8,12; 6:33,36; 7:3; 11:38; 15:7,11,17; 23:8; 26:22; 27:20; 2Chr 29:12; Ezr 10:43; Neh 11:9; Joel 1:1). English convention: Joel. 'YHWH-is-Mighty-One'.
Son of Issachar (Gen 46:13). Hyphenated to distinguish from Job (H347). English convention: Job (in Issachar context).
Multiple persons including Edomite king (Gen 10:29; 36:33,34; Josh 11:1; 1Chr 1:23,44,45; 8:9,18). English convention: Jobab.

50th-year of release, also rams-horn announcing it (Ex 19:13; Lev 25:9-54; 27:17-24; Num 36:4; Josh 6:4-13). Standard concordant 'jubilee' (transliteration). The horn-and-year-of-release coalesce in single Hebrew lexeme.
Father of musicians (Gen 4:21). English convention: Jubal.
Multiple Levites and officials (1Chr 12:4,20; 2Chr 31:13; 35:9; Ezr 8:33; 10:22,23; Neh 8:7; 11:16). English convention: Jozabad.
Benjamite and David's hero (1Chr 8:16; 11:45). English convention: Joha.
Wall-builder and high-priest (Neh 3:6; 12:10,11,22; 13:28). English convention: Joiada.
Multiple priests (Ezr 8:16; Neh 11:5,10; 12:6,19). English convention: Joiarib.

From √naphash (breathe); the breathing-throat / life-force / animate-self. 755 occurrences. The most-frequent abstract-noun in OT. Considered: soul, life, self, person, breath, throat, desire. The Hebrew kernel is the breathing-living-creature (Gen 2:7 'man became a living nephesh'); the same word covers human (Gen 2:7), animal (Gen 1:20-24; 9:10-16), corpse (Lev 21:1; Num 6:6 — 'dead nephesh'), the seat-of-desire (Deu 12:15; 14:26), and the personal-pronoun-substitute (Num 19:13). KJV uniformly 'soul'; ESV/NIV split 'soul/life/person'. Concordant 'soul' is preserved across all 755 occurrences with the toelichting noting that Hebrew nephesh is not the immortal-soul of Greek-philosophy: nephesh dies (Eze 18:4 'the soul that sins shall die') and nephesh is identified with blood (Gen 9:4-5; Lev 17:11). The breathing-throat / life-force kernel is preserved through the single rendering.

From √alam (be-hidden / be-distant); the long-and-distant time-period — both backward (Pro 22:28 'ancient landmark') and forward (Ex 12:14 'an ordinance forever'). 436 occurrences — second-most-frequent abstract-noun in OT after nephesh. Considered: forever, eternal, everlasting, age-lasting, perpetual. KJV uniformly 'for ever / everlasting / eternal'; ESV varies. The seven-anchor analysis: the Hebrew kernel is the bounded-but-long time-period, often paired with 'va-ed' (and-future-perpetuity, H5703) to express 'ever-and-ever' — the doubling demonstrates that olam alone is not strictly eternal/timeless. The phrase 'olam va-ed' is the OT idiom for the ever-extending. Concordant 'age-lasting' (hyphenated) preserves the bounded-eonion aspect: olam describes a long time-period (an age), not an absolute eternity. The toelichting notes the paired 'olam va-ed' formulary. This decision aligns with Concordant Version (Knoch) tradition and is critical for the eschatology-vocabulary (especially aionios in NT-Greek, the LXX-cognate).

Num-uitspraak-Bileam-zoon-Beor-uitspraak-man-ontloken-oog en Num-uitspraak-Bileam-zoon-Beor-uitspraak-man-ontloken-oog (Num 24:3,15). Gehyphenateerd om geopend-ontloken-ziende-aspect te onderscheiden van andere zien-termen; Bileam-extase-visioen-formule-tweemaal-orakel-openings-formule.

Van √bo (binnenkomen); wat de akker binnenbrengt, landbouwopbrengst; concordant 'opbrengst'.
Van √bin (onderscheiden); het vermogen om door te dringen; onderscheiden van chokmah (wijsheid) en daat (kennis); concordant 'inzicht'.

Prominente kegelvormige berg aan oost-rand van Jizreël-vlakte (Joz 19:22 grens Zebulon-Issachar-Naftali, Ri 4:6,12,14 Debora-Barak-verzamelplaats tegen Sisera 'ga op Tabor', 8:18 Gideons-wraak op-koningen voor broers-gedood 'op Tabor'); metaforisch (Ps 89:13 'Tabor en Hermon juichen in-uw-naam', Jer 46:18 'zoals Tabor onder-bergen', Hos 5:1 'net gespannen over Tabor'); ook plaatsnaam Tabor in Levitisch-erfgoed (1Kr 6:77) en Tabor-eik (1Sa 10:3); concordant getranslitereerd.

Lev-vrouw-staan-voor-beest-tot-paring-schande-is-het en Lev-indien-man-neemt-vrouw-en-dochter-schande-is-het (Lev 18:23; 20:12). Gehyphenateerd om schande-bloedschande-verwarring-aspect te onderscheiden van H8398 tebel 'wereld' (reeds toegewezen) als homograaf; familie met H1101 balal 'mengen-verwarren' (reeds toegewezen) — incest-verbod-bloedschennis-term.
Bewoonbare wereld, in parallel met erets (aarde); concordant 'aardrijk'.
Gedorst afval van graanstelen, stro; concordant 'kaf' (onderscheiden van qash 'stoppel' en motz 'wan-afval').
Tibni-zoon-van-Ginath-koningspretendent-tegen-Omri (1 Kg 16:21,22 tweemaal). Dutch-traditie: Tibni. 'Bouw-van-JHWH' of 'mijn-stro' (familie-met teven-stro reeds toegewezen).
Van √banah (bouwen); ontwerp, afbeelding als voorbeeld; samengesteld NL markeert functie (Mozes kreeg tavnit van tabernakel).

Num-noemde-plaats-naam-Brand-HEEREN-brandde-onder-hen en Deut-ook-in-Taberah-en-te-Massa-en-te-Kibroth-Tanawa-hebt-gij-HEERE-getergd (Num 11:3; Deut 9:22). Gehyphenateerd om Taverah-plaats-brand-woestijn-aspect te onderscheiden van andere plaatsnamen; familie met H1197 ba'ar 'branden' (reeds toegewezen) — woestijn-plaatsnaam-straf-vuur-herinnering.
Tebes-stad waar Abimelech-door-molensteen-sterft-van-vrouwenhand (Ri 9:50; 2 Sam 11:21). Dutch-traditie: Tebes. 'Schitterend' of 'wit-glanzend'.
Assyrische koning die Noord-Israël deporteerde (2 Kg 15:29; 16:7,10; 1 Kr 5:6,26; 2 Kr 28:20). Dutch-traditie: Tiglat-Pileser.

Boomsoort tidhar (mogelijk den- of iepsoort) — in Jesaja 41:19 (Ik zal in de woestijn den ceder, den sittimboom en den mirt en den olijfboom stellen; Ik zal in de wildernis samen zetten den dennenboom, den tidhar en den busboom) en Jesaja 60:13 (de heerlijkheid van Libanon zal tot u komen, de dennenboom, de tidhar en de busboom); paronomasie-paar met H8391 teashshur in beide verzen.

Aramees bijwoord voor voortdurend of bestendig — in Daniël 6:17 (uw God dien gij geduriglijk eert) en Daniël 6:21 (uw God dien gij geduriglijk eert); karakteriseert Daniëls onafgebroken trouw aan God in leeuwenkuil-narratief.

1K-hij-bouwde-Thadmor-in-de-woestijn en 2Kr-en-Thadmor-in-de-woestijn-en-alle-schatsteden-die-hij-bouwde-in-Hamath (1K 9:18; 2Kr 8:4). Gehyphenateerd om Tadmor-woestijn-stad-Salomo-aspect te onderscheiden van andere plaatsen; Palmyra-oude-naam-woestijn-handelsroute-Salomo-vestingwerken.

Gen-Tidal-koning-Gojim-coalitie-met-Amrafel-Arjoch-Kedorlaomer en Gen-dezelfde-coalitie-herhaling (Gen 14:1,9). Gehyphenateerd om Tidal-koning-Gojim-coalitie-aspect te onderscheiden van andere; mogelijk-Hittitisch-Tudhalia-koningscoalitie.
Formloze chaos in Gen 1:2 (tohu wavohu); ook ijdelheid, leegte; concordant 'woestheid'.
Kosmische oerwateren uit Gen 1:2; diepe waterkolom, oceaan-abyssus; concordant 'oervloed' (onderscheiden van yam zee).
Van √halal II (prijzen); het object/de daad van lof; concordant 'lofprijs'.
God beschuldigt zelfs engelen van dwaasheid; Job 4:18.
Van hafak 'omkeren'. Plural-karakter verdraaide-spraak of verkeerde-handelingen (Deu 32:20; Spr 2:12,14; 6:14; 8:13; 10:31,32; 16:28,30; 23:33). Gehyphenateerd niet nodig; inherent abstract-plural.

Het merkteken op het voorhoofd van de gemerkten — Job 31:35 (zie, hier is mijn merkteken — de Almachtige antwoorde mij) en Ezechiël 9:4-6 (zet een merkteken op de voorhoofden der mannen die zuchten); de letter taw fungeerde als kruis-merk.
Aramees 'teruggeven/terugkeren' in Daniël en Ezra (Ezra 5:5,11; 6:5; Dan 4:31,33; 6:10; 7:9 (?); 2:14). Concordant gekoppeld via '-Aram' aan Hebreeuws H7725 shuv.
Zoon van Jafet; volkerentabel-naam gekoppeld aan regio in klein-Azië (Gen 10:2; 1 Kr 1:5; Jes 66:19; Ez 27:13; 32:26; 38:2,3; 39:1). Ook verbonden in Tubal-Kaïn (H8423, apart).

Gen-Tsilla-baarde-Tubal-Kaïn-smid-koper-en-ijzer en Ez-Meshech-en-Tubal-handelen en Jes-Tubal-en-Javan-ver-gelegen-kusten (Gen 4:22; Ez 27:13; 32:26; 38:2; 39:1; Jes 66:19). Gehyphenateerd om Tubal-zoon-van-Kaïn-smid-voorvader-aspect te onderscheiden van andere stam-eponiemen; smidsvaardigheid-eerste-metaalbewerker.

Spr-dwaze-zoon-droefheid-moeder en Spr-vrolijk-hart-kwam-van-vreugde en Ps-droefheid-uit-mijn-zucht (Ps 119:28; Spr 10:1; 14:13; 17:21). Gehyphenateerd om droefheid-smart-hartverdriet-kwelling-aspect te onderscheiden van H3014 yagah 'droefheid-bereiden' (reeds toegewezen) en H3015 yagon 'hartverdriet' (reeds toegewezen); familie met H3013 yagah 'droef-doen-zijn' — hartkwelling-abstractie.
Japhet-afstammeling en noordelijke handels-natie (Gen 10:3; 1 Kr 1:6; Ez 27:14; 38:6). Dutch-traditie: Togarma. Armenië.
Van √yadah (belijden/danken); dankbaar lied en dankoffer; samengesteld NL dekt aanbiddingsaspect.

1S-en-hij-stelde-zich-verandert-in-hun-ogen-en-hij-raaskalde-onder-hun-handen-en-hij-krabbelde-op-de-deuren-der-poort (1S 21:13). Gehyphenateerd om krab-marken-aan-wanden-krassen-tekenen-aspect te onderscheiden van H2901 tavah-spinnen-weven (reeds toegewezen) als homograaf-wortel; David-Achis-Gath-krankzinnigheids-veinzing-deur-krabbelen-baard-speeksel-vluchtstrategie.
Aramees Peal; Nebukadnezar-verbaasd-staart in oven; Dan 3:24.
Eigennaam Levi-vader Eliab Samuels-genealogie; 1Kron 6:34; concordant getranslitereerd.

Uitkijkend-wachten op beloofde vervulling (Job 41:1; Ps 39:8; Spr 10:28; 11:7; 13:12; Klg 3:18). Gehyphenateerd om aanhoudend-uitwachten-aspect te onderscheiden van H8615b tiqvah 'hoopvolle-verwachting'; familie met H3176 yachal 'wachten-hopen'.
Uniek lexeem. Spatieel centrum. 'Midden' bewaart het lokatie-begrip.

Godsbestraffing of wijs-onderwijs door tucht (Ps 39:12; 73:14; Spr 1:23,25,30; Hos 5:9). Gehyphenateerd om bestraf-kastijd-aspect te onderscheiden van homoniem H8433b tochachat 'terechtwijzing' (reeds toegewezen) en H4148 musar 'tucht' (reeds toegewezen); familie met H3198 yakhach 'terechtwijzen'.
Van √yachach (redetwisten); correctie in woord, oordeel; concordant 'terechtwijzing'.
Van √yalad (baren); register van afstammelingen, ontstaansgeschiedenis; samengesteld NL behoudt genealogisch aspect.

1Kr-en-de-zonen-van-Sjimon-Amnon-en-Rinna-Ben-Hanan-en-Tilon en 1Kr-id (1 Kr 4:20). Gehyphenateerd om Tolon-zoon-Sjimon-Juda-Amnon-Rinna-Ben-Hanan-tak-aspect te onderscheiden van andere Tl-namen; Juda-genealogie-fragment-vier-Sjimon-zonen-Amnon-Rinna-Ben-Hanan-Tilon-laatste-genoemd-stam-onderverdeling.

Rode kleur-stof uit cochenille-worm (Ex 25:4; 26:1,31,36; Jes 1:18; 41:14). Gehyphenateerd om scharlaken-verf-aspect te onderscheiden van homoniem H8438b tola-II 'worm-mens' en H8144 shani 'scharlaken'; familie met H8439 Tola (reeds toegewezen).
Made of cochenille-worm (bron van karmozijn-verf); negatief ook voor nietigheid; concordant 'worm'.
Richter van Issachar en Issacharitische stamvader (Gen 46:13; Num 26:23; Ri 10:1,2; 1 Kr 7:1,2). Dutch-traditie: Tola.
Patroniem-clan zoon Issaschar; Num 26:23; concordant getranslitereerd.
Wortel t'b (verafschuwen). 'Gruwel' bewaart de afkeer-geladen kern; 'afschuw' is emotioneler, 'gruwel' is de concordante Nederlandse conventie.

Kracht-volle-hoornen of heuvel-pieken (Num 23:22; 24:8; Job 22:25; Ps 95:4). Gehyphenateerd om toppen-hoornkracht-aspect te onderscheiden van H7218 rosh 'top' en H1389 giv'ah 'heuvel'; familie met H3286 yaaf 'moe-zijn'.
Van √yatsa (uitgaan); grensuitlopers van gebied, uitkomsten van leven (Spr 4:23); concordant 'uitloop'.

Neh-en-Mattanja-Bakbukja-Obadja-Mesjullam-Talmon-Akkub-waren-poortwachters-die-de-wacht-hielden-bij-de-magazijnen-der-poorten (Neh 11:17 textvariant ms-Toda). Gehyphenateerd om Toda-Levitisch-Asaf-loftempel-zonen-Tweede-tempel-genealogie-aspect te onderscheiden van H8426 todah-dankoffer (reeds toegewezen) als translit-homograaf; familie met H8426 — 'dankloof-eigennaam'-Levitisch-Asaf-tempelzanger-genealogie-Tweede-tempel-loflied-koor-textvariant-Mattanja-Toda.
Qal: rondtrekken om te onderzoeken (land, goederen); concordant 'verkennen'.

Beurt-lijst-volgorde van vrouwen bij koning en halsketting-vlechten (Est 2:12,15; Hgl 1:10,11). Gehyphenateerd om beurt-rij-vlecht-aspect te onderscheiden van H8448 tor 'koopman-rij' en H7169 qishqesheth 'schub-vlechtwerk'.
Kleine wilde duif, alternatief offer voor armen (Lev 5, 12); samengesteld NL onderscheidt van tor 'rei/beurt'.
Aramees-equivalent voor stier-offerdier (Ezra 6:9,17; 7:17; Dan 4:22,29,30; 5:21). Gehyphenateerd om Aramees-parallel aan te duiden; familie met H7794 shor 'stier' (Hebreeuws).
Wortel yrh (onderwijzen, aanwijzen, H3384). 'Wet' dekt de normatieve instructie; 'onderwijzing' is etymologisch zuiverder maar minder courant in Nederlands.
Van √yashav (wonen); niet-inheemse inwoner, pelgrim-vreemdeling (naast 'ger'); samengesteld NL markeert tijdelijk verblijf.
Tweede zin toshav; Elia ziet zichzelf als gast-vreemde uit Gilead; 1Kon 17:1.

Effectieve wijsheid die doel bereikt; goddelijk attribuut (Job 11:6, 12:16, 26:3, Spr 2:7, 8:14, 18:1, Jes 28:29, Mi 6:9) en menselijke kwaliteit (Spr 3:21); samengesteld NL onderscheidt van chokhmah door praktisch-resultaat-aspect.
Van √zanah (hoereren); veelvoudige ontrouw, vaak verbondsmetafoor; concordant 'hoererij'.
Koers-bepalend-beleid, raadgevingen van leiderschap (Job 37:12; Spr 1:5; 11:14; 12:5; 20:18; 24:6). Gehyphenateerd om zeilende-stuurmanskunst-metafoor te bewaren.

Aramese-plaatsaanwijzing onder-boom en onder-hemel (Dan 2:38; 4:11,12,14,20,21,22; Jer 10:11). Gehyphenateerd om onder-beneden-Aram-aspect te onderscheiden van H8478 tachath 'onder' (reeds toegewezen); Aramese cognaat.

Land-kwalen als oordeels-bezoekingen (Deut 29:21; 2 Kr 21:19; Ps 103:3; Jer 14:18; 16:4). Gehyphenateerd om ziekte-kwel-aspect te onderscheiden van H2483 choli 'ziekte' en H4341 makh'ov 'smart'; familie met H2470 chalah 'krank-zijn'.

Lev-en-struisvogel-en-nachtuil-en-tachmas-en-haviken-niet-eten en Deut-struisvogel-nachtuil-tachmas-haviken (Lev 11:16; Deut 14:15). Gehyphenateerd om struisvogel-ooruil-onrein-aspect te onderscheiden van andere vogels; familie met H2554 chamas 'geweld-doen' (reeds toegewezen) — gewelddadige-roofvogel-etymologie.

Num-uit-Tahan-Tahaniet en 1Kr-zoons-Efraïm-Sutelah-Tahan (Num 26:35; 1Kr 7:25 vgl). Gehyphenateerd om Tachan-zoon-Efraïm-stam-aspect te onderscheiden van andere namen; Efraïm-kleinzoon-stamvader-Tahanieten-geslacht.
Van √chanan (gunstig zijn); gebed om genade, pleitrede; concordant 'smeekbede'.
Van √chanan (genadig zijn); herhaalde smeekgebeden om genade; samengesteld NL markeert pleurend karakter (plurale tantum).
Patroniem-clan zoon Efraïm; Num 26:35; concordant getranslitereerd.
Egyptische grensvesting in de Nijldelta waar de ballingen Jeremia meevoerden (Jer 2:16; 43:7,8,9; 44:1; 46:14; Ez 30:18). Dutch-traditie: Tachpanches.

Wedijveren of wedlopen — in Jeremia 12:5 (hoe zoudt gij u mengen in den hoogmoed van de Jordaan?) en Jeremia 22:15 (meent gij dat gij koning zult zijn omdat gij u mengt met den ceder?); onderscheiden van H2893 taharah (reinheid) door wortel-suffix.
Eigennaam Benjamin-zoon Mica afstammeling Jonatan; 1Kron 9:41; concordant getranslitereerd.
Onzekere zeediervel (dolfijn/zeekoe/narwal) voor tabernakelbedekking en sandalen; samengesteld NL markeert waterdier-oorsprong.
Eigennaam zoon van Nahor; Gen 22:24; concordant getranslitereerd.
Voorzetsel van positie-onder. Ook 'in plaats van' (onder iemand komen). 'Onder' dekt beide.
Aramees parallel aan tachat; dieren-onder-boom; Dan 4:14.
Verscheidene Levitische en Efraïmitische personen (Num 33:26,27; 1 Kr 6:9,22; 7:20). 'Beneden-onder'. Dutch-traditie: Tachat.
Van √tachat (onder); benedenste deel (aarde, stad, grot); concordant 'onderste'.
Eigennaam streek noord van Galilea volkstelling; 2Sam 24:6; concordant getranslitereerd.

Bijvoeglijk adjectief van tavek (midden, H8432); in-midden-geplaatst als-positie-specificatie onderscheiden van qerev (binnenste) (Ex 26:28, 36:33 tabernakel-plank 'middenste dwarsbalk in-midden-van-planken-doorgaand van-einde tot-einde', Ri 7:19 Gideons-drie-honderd 'begin-van-middenste-nachtwake gekomen voor-kamp-van-Midjan', 1Kon 6:6, 6:8 Salomo's-tempel 'middenste zijkamer was-vijf-el breed, en-de-derde was-zes-el breed... ingang-van-middenste-zijkamer op-rechterzijde-van-het-huis', 2Kon 20:4 = Jes 38:5 Hizkia's gebed 'niet uitgekomen was-Jesaja nog middenste-hof', Ez 41:7 gezien-tempel 'zij-omgingen zich-opwaarts-opwaarts, want omgang van-het-huis was-opwaarts-opwaarts rondom het-huis... van-laagste-zijkamer tot-de-hoogste door middelste', 42:5 'zijkamers hoogste waren-korter, want galerijen verminderden van-hen, van-laagste en-van-middelste van-het-gebouw'); samengesteld 'middenste' bijvoeglijk specificatie-positie onderscheiden van midden-substantief.
Zoon van Ismaël en oase-stam in Noord-Arabië (Gen 25:15; 1 Kr 1:30; Job 6:19; Jes 21:14; Jer 25:23). Dutch-traditie: Tema; familie met H8489 Teman-II 'Temaniet'.
Windrichting en gebied ten zuiden; ook gelijknamige eigennaam (Edom); samengesteld NL voor gewone noun-gebruik.
Zoon van Elifaz, kleinzoon Esau (Gen 36:11,15,42, 1Kr 1:36,53); regio in Edom bekend om wijsheid (Jer 49:7,20, Ez 25:13, Am 1:12, Oba 1:9, Hab 3:3); concordant getranslitereerd.
Bewoner van Teiman (Edomitisch gebied); Elifaz de Temaniet is Job's vriend (Gen 36:11,15,42; 1 Kr 1:45,53; Job 2:11; 4:1; 15:1; 22:1; 42:7,9). Adjectief-afgeleide van H8487 Teiman.

Rookkolom als palmboomvormige opstijging — in Hooglied 3:6 (wie is zij die opkomt uit de woestijn als rookkolommen van mirre en wierook) en Joël 3:3 (bloed en vuur en rookkolommen); afgeleid van tamar (palmboom) door vormvergelijking.
Jong vruchtensap uit geperste druiven, vaak in drieslag met dagan en yitshar; concordant 'most'.

Gen-zonen-Jafet-Gomer-Magog-Madai-Javan-Tubal-Mesech-en-Tiras en 1Kr-zonen-Jafet-Tiras (Gen 10:2; 1Kr 1:5). Gehyphenateerd om Tiras-zoon-Jafet-volkereneponiem-aspect te onderscheiden van Hiran-Hiram-andere-volkeren (reeds toegewezen); volkerentafel-Jafet-lijn-derde-generatie.
Volwassen geite-bok als geschenk (Gen 30:35; 32:15; Spr 30:31; 2 Kr 17:11). Gehyphenateerd om ram-bok-aspect te onderscheiden van H8163a sa'ir 'bok' en H6260 attud 'leider-bok'.

Ps-bedrog-en-list-wijken-niet-van-haar-straten en Spr-bedrog-en-valsheid en Ps-onderdrukking-en-bedrog (Ps 10:7; 55:12; Spr 29:13). Gehyphenateerd om bedrog-onderdrukking-onrecht-list-aspect te onderscheiden van H4820 mirmah 'bedrog' (reeds toegewezen) en H6233 osheq 'onderdrukking' (reeds toegewezen) en homoniem H8432 tavekh 'midden' (reeds toegewezen); sociale-onrecht-term-stadspoort-context.

Inrichting of verhoudings-planning — in Ezechiël 43:11 (toon hun de gedaante van het huis en de gestalte daarvan, en zijn uitgangen, en zijn ingangen, en al zijn gedaanten, en al zijn inzettingen, ja al zijn gedaanten en al zijn wetten) en Nahum 2:9 (er is geen einde aan zijn voorraad); van H3559 kun (vestigen, toebereiden).
Job verlangt te-komen tot Gods-zetel; Job 23:3.

1K-de-vloot-van-Hiram-bracht-ivoor-apen-en-pauwen en 2Kr-bracht-apen-en-pauwen-elpenbeen (1K 10:22; 2Kr 9:21). Gehyphenateerd om pauwen-exotische-vogel-import-aspect te onderscheiden van andere vogels; Salomo-handel-elke-drie-jaar-Ofir-Tarsis-pauwen-aapjes-bijzonder-buitenlands.

Uiterste-einde-grens van volmaaktheid en uitzicht (Job 11:7; 26:10; 28:3; Neh 3:21; Ps 139:22). Gehyphenateerd om volkomen-einde-aspect te onderscheiden van H7093 qets 'einde' (reeds toegewezen) en H7097 qatseh 'grens-rand' (reeds toegewezen); familie met H3615 kalah 'voleinden'.
Blauw-violette verfstof uit zeeslak; kleur van priesterkleding en snoeren; concordant 'violet'.

Ez-in-de-rantsoen-zult-gij-uw-koren-afwegen en Ex-gij-zult-geen-stro-geven-en-rantsoen-van-tichelstenen-zult-gij-opleggen (Ex 5:18; Ez 45:11). Gehyphenateerd om rantsoen-hoeveelheid-vastgestelde-maat-aspect te onderscheiden van H8505 takhan 'meten-afwegen' (reeds toegewezen); Farao-werklast-en-Ezechiëls-maat-visioen.

Maatpatroon of bouwplan volgens verhouding — in Ezechiël 28:12 (gij verzegelaar der sommen, vol van wijsheid en volmaakt in schoonheid) en Ezechiël 43:10 (opdat zij zich schamen vanwege hun ongerechtigheden, en laat hen het patroon meten); architecturale-esthetische verhoudingsmaat.
Puinheuvel van vernietigde stad (Deut 13:17; Jos 8:28; 11:13; Jer 30:18; 49:2). Gehyphenateerd om puin-heuvel-aspect te onderscheiden van H2022 har 'berg' en H1389 giv'ah 'heuvel'.

Deut-uw-leven-zal-u-tegenover-hangen-en-gij-zult-bevreesd-zijn-dag-en-nacht en Hos-mijn-volk-blijft-mij-twijfelachtig-al-wordt-het-tot-Allerhoogste-geroepen (Deut 28:66; Hos 11:7 vgl). Gehyphenateerd om hangend-onzeker-hangend-aan-twijfel-aspect te onderscheiden van andere hang-termen; familie met H8518 talah 'ophangen' (reeds toegewezen) — vloek-Deuteronomium-levens-zekerheid-weg-en-Hosea-volk-afdwalend.
Eigennaam ballingschap-plaats waar Ezechiël zat; Eze 3:15; concordant getranslitereerd.

Uitputting van woestijn-reis of kwaad (Ex 18:8; Num 20:14; Klg 3:5; Mal 1:13; Neh 9:32). Gehyphenateerd om vermoeienis-tobber-aspect te onderscheiden van H3021 yaga 'moeite' en H5999 amal 'zwoeg'; familie met H3811 la'ah 'moe-worden'.

2K-hebben-de-goden-der-volkeren-die-mijn-vaderen-verdorven-hebben-uitgered-als-Gozan-en-Haran-en-Rezef-en-de-kinderen-van-Eden-die-in-Telassar-zijn en Jes-id (2K 19:12; Jes 37:12 par). Gehyphenateerd om Telassar-Eden-stad-Assyrisch-verovering-bewijsstuk-aspect te onderscheiden van andere Tel-stadsnamen; Sanherib-brief-aan-Hizkia-historische-bewijslijst-veroverde-koninkrijken-Bit-Adini-Aramees-vorstendom-machts-argument-grootspraak.
Qal: aan een paal of boom hangen (voorwerp, lichaam, gezicht); concordant 'ophangen'.

Van √lun-II (morren, H3885b); nominale-vorm voor verzamelnaam van klacht-tegen-gezag-of-lot (Ex 16:7-9,12 woestijn-murmurering 'uw gemor tegen JHWH gehoord-heeft... wat zijn-wij dat-gij-uw gemor tegen ons zou-zijn? niet-tegen-ons is-uw gemor, maar tegen-JHWH... Ik-heb-gehoord gemor-van-Israëls-kinderen, spreek tot-hen zeggend: tussen-de-twee-avonden zult-gij-eten vlees', Num 14:27 JHWH-spreekt 'hoe-lang deze-boze-vergadering die tegen-mij gemoren, gemoren-van-Israëls-kinderen welke-zij tegen-mij gemoren, Ik-heb-gehoord', 17:5,10 Aärons-staf-bloeiend 'en-gij-zult-weg-nemen de gemor-van-kinderen Israëls die zij-tegen-u-morren', 17:20 'en-Ik-zal-doen-ophouden de gemor van-Israëls-kinderen van-tegen-Mij die zij tegen-u gemoren'); concordant 'gemor' nominale-klachtshandeling onderscheiden van morren-werkwoord.
